## Smoother performance, easier dictation, saved phone drafts & clearer workspace controls ✨

Long chats stay more responsive while agents stream tool output, reasoning and subagent work, with less background processing during terminal and tab updates. This update also makes dictation easier to set up and use and makes agents and cloud workspaces easier to manage. Phone-specific improvements below require the matching phone app update.

- 🎙️ **Dictate with less setup:** Voice settings suggests an on-device model for your language and offers one setup button. Add personal or repository vocabulary, remove filler words, and use Auto mode to hold the shortcut or tap to toggle. On-device dictation inserts phrases as you pause, and you can dictate into fields in Orca's browser.
- 📱 **Pick up where you left off:** Chats show their saved recent messages after a phone relaunch while reconnecting. Commit messages, PR descriptions, comments, review notes, tasks and new-workspace drafts survive closing the app.
- ⌨️ **More control from your phone:** The terminal key row gains Shift, Ctrl and Alt latches and an optional Smart rail with agent actions. A floating dictation pill lets you keep speaking while moving to another screen in the app.
- 🤖 **Get agents ready from chat:** Supported missing agents offer installation and sign-in guidance where you start a chat. OpenCode subagents appear in their own cards and keep their chat active while they work; Codex replies can be forked after a rewind.
- 🧭 **Find the controls you need:** The browser groups its tools into an Annotate button and one menu. Settings is easier to scan, and recipe-backed VM workspaces show their lifecycle with Suspend and Resume actions.

## Highlights

- **Voice & dictation:** Speech-model updates are offered in the dictation pill when you start dictating, with download progress, cancellation and retry. Language-based setup suggestions, model quality information, a Use GPU switch, personal and repository vocabulary, and support for OpenAI-compatible transcription services. The dictation pill shows committed and pending words; failed recordings can be retried. Pressing Send or Enter while dictating waits for the words before sending.
- **Phone & recovery:** Saved chat messages and draft text return after a relaunch. Home opens with last-known workspaces, visited terminals stay mounted for quicker switching, and page assets load on demand. Folder workspaces have Source Control on the phone, and large-file diffs retain unchanged lines.
- **Chat & agents:** Copy and other reply actions stay visible on the latest response, while older replies reveal them on hover or keyboard focus. Account usage shows Used, Left and time until reset. Claude chat names use the CLI's titles, questions can show option previews, Codex failures give actionable advice, and a New divider is available in Settings. Usage-limited chats that are due can continue in one pass, with automatic retries stopping after five consecutive failures.
- **Workspaces & remote hosts:** Setup-script import understands more existing repository configurations. VM workspaces show creation progress and failures, and suspended VMs can be resumed from their workspace controls. Paired-server connection failures are detected when the host stops answering.
- **Browser, editor & everyday fixes:** Browser annotation, drawing and element capture share one control, with zoom and viewport state in the address field. Inline or side-by-side diff choice is saved. Linear search and issue lists include the project, and agent speed menus offer the speeds supported by the selected model.

**Dictation upgrade note:** Existing local speech-model downloads may need an update before dictation works again. Complete the download from the dictation pill or Voice settings before relying on dictation offline.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.255...v1.4.256

name: v0.9.33
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.33

Released on 2026-11-11.

Clips that start partway into a voice recording now keep their sound to the end, even when the WAV file misreports its own byte rate. Variable-bound media also renders at the right length and loudness.

## Fixes

- **Engine:** A clip that starts partway into a WAV whose header gives the wrong byte rate now plays the right sound to its end, instead of going quiet early or staying silent ([7ae1ae649](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7ae1ae64942f036a18c546bef024121d8df76ef2), [#7541](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7541)).
- **Share:** When you reach the hourly limit on review versions, the message now explains that limit ([8a15d9fee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8a15d9feedc62dc9695246dceda9271a6d0a08e9), [#7539](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7539)).
- **Projects:** A composition can only look up files inside its own project folder ([5a88c9938](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a88c9938edaf464f7953e762bb40f604623f1b1), [#7534](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7534)).
- **Capture:** A wrong captioning region or model name is reported before captioning starts ([bcc1437d7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bcc1437d77f592d33b794b5544ae98bb3647c6ad), [#7533](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7533)).
- **Producer:** A video or sound set through a variable now renders at its clip's length and loudness ([789d28121](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/789d28121183f72976834d3693329e956f88de88), [#7529](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7529)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Variables:** Say what can be a variable, including a video or sound per account ([28d69d9a9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/28d69d9a94c13b2b39e99d207c2ee595b59781c9), [#7530](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7530)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** Give each test file its own home so renders never wait on another file's lock ([2b86c49dc](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2b86c49dc2cb067051eca1ccf9d0b1d22054719a), [#7526](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7526)).

## Full changelog

name: v0.9.32
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.32

Released on 2026-11-11.

Long films that are slow to open now render instead of failing before their first frame. The CLI, Studio and the renderer also stop a project folder from choosing what they run or serve.

## Features

- SDR MP4 renders can keep full colour detail with `--chroma-subsampling 444`, for masters that will be re-encoded; the default is unchanged ([1a9fb8acb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1a9fb8acb65d044e1732381fad953b69c3604648), [#5820](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5820)).
- **Producer:** The render stream's complete event names the producer version that rendered it ([7afa05a78](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7afa05a782c452ca76af22bdde12d4cddaf64c60), [#7515](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7515)).

## Fixes

- **Share:** Guide recovery when an export replay is refused ([941049a84](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/941049a84470caf3358962577e4c1faeecdfc95d), [#7531](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7531)).
- **Studio:** The composition hover preview runs walled off from Studio's own page, so a composition's scripts cannot reach into Studio ([0c229a26c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0c229a26c9e1ad91a3b1df3b24100be6f10ae3db), [#7522](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7522)).
- **Studio:** Pressing Enter or Escape while an input method is still composing text no longer commits it, and Escape then leaving a text field no longer saves the cancelled edit ([ff285d3f2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ff285d3f2b3a2199e8068f02c192140ed72d2015), [#6011](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6011)).
- **Share:** A share or export killed while taking its lock no longer leaves a lock that later attempts cannot clear, on file systems without hard links ([b37e4b026](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b37e4b026f0cd725ed7588d6648263d5cda1e046), [#7516](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7516)).
- **Producer:** Long films that are slow to open no longer fail before their first frame: the wait for the first frame now follows how long the browser took to start, up to 15 minutes ([7ff8ece46](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7ff8ece461e87282e17f3da14f0b83d0cbe9d38f), [#7517](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7517)).
- **Lint:** Flag a script that calls gsap before GSAP loads, and say so when a render fails on it ([124591a9d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/124591a9d5d54fb90ab9ab832ced2b3af1527d11), [#7514](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7514)).
- **Producer,engine:** Harden render paths, render slots and local listeners ([60fb9d2c5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/60fb9d2c5e0c213787888300dd98b8cb05fc2b31), [#7508](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7508)).
- **Studio Server:** Harden preview paths, cache folders and local servers ([b8bb49190](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b8bb4919003fd5082a0db481271db4baf7701b30), [#7510](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7510)).
- **CLI:** Keep project folders from choosing the programs and config the CLI runs ([84c7d02a1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84c7d02a190f79420cd8c5d112033706fb0a8efc), [#7511](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7511)).
- **CLI:** Harden lambda destroy, snapshot media, upgrade and project file serving ([c96ff540c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c96ff540c4d696929774aee35ab62830caa7146c), [#7509](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7509)).

## Performance

- **Docs:** Load showcase film tiles only when they are near the screen ([fd0c2337c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fd0c2337c5f85cf2c2850a41feeb150a7ef27fe6), [#7507](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7507)).

## Docs & Examples

- List the hub's /blog, /vs and /tools sitemaps in robots.txt ([499a17e67](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/499a17e67139b6ce692481b41c51a397dd274f45), [#7527](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7527)).
- **README:** Show the GitHub rank and skills downloads badges ([717d3d02c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/717d3d02cd819a5b2064d54c623ab7e3856af1c4), [#7519](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7519)).

## Catalog

- Harden docs snippets, SVG sanitizer, lint regexes, GSAP writers and registry pins ([24508ce2d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/24508ce2da7182b2c7b5ca368062c18fb85c489b), [#7512](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7512)).

## Internal

- **Inspector:** Decode file URLs in HTTP contract fixtures ([e7a323ade](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e7a323adefeeea0e5b7478a7bf51c31bc290c759), [#6010](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6010)).

## Full changelog

name: v0.9.31
body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.31

Released on 2026-11-10.

In Safari, long videos no longer load the whole file at once, and playing clips keep their source. The Studio dev server now checks the Host on its API routes, so a tunnel or remote setup may need one setting.

## Fixes

- **Core:** In Safari, a small video file keeps its preload, and a clip that is playing keeps its source ([cda84222a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cda84222aa12716f2ceb92b45629487be81a0601), [#7498](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7498)).
- **Studio:** The Studio dev server now checks the Host header on its API routes too, as the preview server does since 0.9.30. A tunnel, Codespaces or remote dev host that worked before can now get a 403: name the host in `HYPERFRAMES_PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOSTS` (comma separated), which now also reaches the dev server's own allowed hosts ([b0835262a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b0835262ae5179f27d95ac2d140298f83fbf2fd1), [#7493](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7493)).
- **Studio Server:** Thumbnail links take their origin from the server, and previews from other sites open sandboxed ([983e865ad](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/983e865ad7ac8e6e6737eff229949d181934ed39), [#7492](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7492)).
- **Producer:** A render that loads the default GSAP file from the CDN uses the copy the CLI already ships, so it works with no network ([5c5799975](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5c579997562578a6b0a946d10b4410a23e5f4029), [#7388](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7388)).
- **CLI:** The message about another install shadowing this one only names an install its package manager can move ([b28bd2b34](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b28bd2b3482a6bcb04d0d0ba0eaee74fbb965455), [#7499](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7499)).
- **Studio:** Messages that count clips or keyframes say 1 clip, not 1 clips ([ec30de062](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ec30de06278300882a898f5fa0b27a599e0dd550), [#7496](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7496)).
- **Studio Server:** When a file is still changing, a claim waits for its first copy, so the edit can still be undone ([248f56fba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/248f56fbaa08aa9167ff44b10764df526c90a921), [#7497](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7497)).

## Performance

- **Core:** In Safari, the clips of a long video no longer load the whole file at once ([fecde9992](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fecde9992fba422e56df4dedc84940bda47ce75e), [#7436](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7436)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Docs:** The adopters list adds DoneCut ([0b531bc7a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0b531bc7a4635b8ede475522f21bfc451f0c6320), [#5638](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5638)).

## Internal

- **Release:** Hardened release build.

body:
### Minor Changes

- [#2489](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2489) [`b52aae2`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/b52aae2349d67198a1908c29b0397e94d140b661) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - feat(languages): translate into European Portuguese. Portuguese is now listed as Brazilian Portuguese and European Portuguese. Existing Portuguese settings become Brazilian Portuguese, which DeepL is now asked for by name; to get European Portuguese from DeepL, pick European Portuguese

- [#2490](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2490) [`409b8ed`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/409b8edb09d0e85253036b51001122367f81d9d4) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - feat(site-rules): get site translation fixes without waiting for an extension update. Built-in site rules now update every six hours from rules.readfrog.app. Each update is signed and checked against what the installed version supports, and the rules bundled with the extension stay in use whenever an update is unavailable

### Patch Changes

- [#2479](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2479) [`38e0091`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/38e00917aa5c1b0646cbd0ab52a74394a2a4e67b) Thanks [@mengxi-ream](https://github.com/mengxi-ream)! - fix(content): make page translation, the selection toolbar and the floating button work again in Chrome 130 and 131, where they had not loaded since 1.52.1

- [#2489](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2489) [`b52aae2`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/b52aae2349d67198a1908c29b0397e94d140b661) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - fix(languages): send each language to translation services under its own code. Cantonese is translated into Cantonese instead of Mandarin, Central Kurdish into Sorani instead of Kurmanji on Google, and Filipino works on Microsoft; 20 languages that failed on Google, and 6 on Microsoft, now translate. Malay translations run left to right, AI translation no longer asks for Malay in Arabic script or Azerbaijani, Uzbek and Bosnian in Cyrillic, and Albanian and Mongolian pages are recognized. Translations carry the language's full tag in their `lang` attribute (`zh-Hans`, `pt-BR`, `yue`) instead of a two-letter code, so custom CSS that matches `[lang="zh"]` should use `:lang(zh)`

- [#2488](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2488) [`70f1c5a`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/70f1c5ac26a802999778c3b19bfaf3db99266459) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - fix(site-rules): translate all of LowEndTalk, including the category and page descriptions, latest-post titles, search results and comment headers that the built-in rule had left in English

- [#2482](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2482) [`9abe9a7`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/9abe9a7a1be9c273799b0ba72405bc2118232c7e) Thanks [@ananaBMaster](https://github.com/ananaBMaster)! - fix(page-translation): translate Markdown files that the browser shows as plain text, such as a raw SKILL.md. Site rules can now target a kind of document with `contentTypes`, and every URL, local files included, with `<all_urls>`

- [#2484](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2484) [`df6aa54`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/df6aa54bee4456549061f74359272cea4e0a2730) Thanks [@xuing](https://github.com/xuing)! - fix(context-menu): stop logging an uncaught "Receiving end does not exist" error when a context menu item is clicked on a page Read Frog cannot run on

- [#2486](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2486) [`b84bbc6`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/b84bbc6ca6b6f5fcf016dc6dced2e57ce36c13ce) Thanks [@mengxi-ream](https://github.com/mengxi-ream)! - fix(site-rules): translate the "For you" home feed on Threads when you are logged in. A site rule meant to skip Threads' nav items and like/reply counts also covered the container around the whole feed, so nothing on that page was translated

- [#2487](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/pull/2487) [`ee31f32`](https://github.com/mengxi-ream/read-frog/commit/ee31f322576fc09c943c5fdf803993b2a21f730c) Thanks [@mengxi-ream](https://github.com/mengxi-ream)! - fix(site-rules): translate X posts when logged out and GitHub org repository descriptions

name: v18.18.8
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed concurrent OAuth requests rejected as `claude_code_version_too_old` failing instead of retrying with the required version ([#18651](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18651))
- Chat Completions gateway requests preserve explicit tool strict-mode choices, so Codex tools can omit optional arguments when callers set `strict: false` ([#18672](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18672) by [@0xeb](https://github.com/0xeb)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Muse Ember (`muse-ember-1.0`) on Meta Model API and Muse Code with the `minimal`–`max` reasoning effort ladder and its >200K long-context pricing
- Added Gemini 4 Carbon pricing on the Gemini API, Vertex AI, Google Antigravity, and Cursor ($2 input / $0.10 cached / $10 output per 1M tokens through 2026-11-30, then $4 / $0.20 / $20), instead of showing $0 ([#18734](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18734) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))

### Fixed

- Fixed regenerating the catalog marking 18 reasoning models as non-reasoning when NanoGPT's `<id>:thinking` sibling row had larger limits ([#18673](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18673), [#18728](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18728))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Changed

- `curl -fsSL https://omp.sh/install | sh` and `install.ps1` now install the standalone binary by default, even when bun is present, so installs get delta updates; pass `--source`/`-Source` for a bun package install
- Ask forms can attach notes to selected options; those notes accompany the answers separately from submitted form values ([#18779](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18779) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))

### Fixed

- Claude auto-redeem now spends a full saved reset on an account blocked by its weekly limit when the reset also clears the Fable cap; such resets were treated as Fable-only and skipped while Fable usage had room ([#18801](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18801))
- Fixed agents showing as idle in the Agent Hub while still running after a failed streaming edit preview (`edit.streamingAbort`) auto-recovered the turn ([#18790](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18790) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- A browser call on a tab that is not open now says to open it with `await browser.open({ name })` (Python: `await browser.open(name=…)`) and the url and app it was opened with, instead of pointing at the removed `action:"open"` ([#18739](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18739) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `computer.window({ app })` and `computer.windows({ app })` matching similarly named apps when the exact app name has an open window, such as Google Chrome alongside Google Chrome for Testing ([#18744](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18744) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- In Tern, browser `role/` selectors keep input roles and names under Turkish and Azeri locales ([#18658](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18658) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Chrome `role/RootWebArea` waits with `visible` return the document instead of failing, and `hidden` waits keep waiting ([#18658](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18658) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- An `omp -p` or other omp that your session's bash tool or eval cell starts inside Tern or cmux no longer picks Tern or cmux from the pane it inherited, so its browser tabs stop floating over your pane ([#18773](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18773) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Browser relay connections sharing a tab no longer lose cross-site frames when another connection disables auto-attachment on its page; automatic children detach locally when their last armed page leaves, while explicitly attached frame subtrees remain usable after opting out ([#18657](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18657) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Browser agents now say when a step can't be done through the page, instead of patching the page with scripts and reporting the step as done ([#18761](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18761) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- An extension's `assistant_message` rewrite now reaches the next Codex Responses request: same-model native replay used to resend the captured original text while the transcript showed the rewritten one ([#18312](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18312))
- MCP reconnects and tool-list refreshes now keep extension-deactivated tools inactive while enabling newly discovered tools ([#18678](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18678)).
- Exiting after aborting a `bash` command now waits for its TERM-resistant foreground processes to be killed ([#18669](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18669)).
- An `edit` touching several files that anchors lines no read displayed now reveals those lines for every file in one rejection, so the identical resend applies instead of being rejected again for the next file ([#18742](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18742) by [@MaisonnatM](https://github.com/MaisonnatM))
- `omp auth-gateway stdio` now serves judge, image, speech, embedding, rerank and video models: `/v1/models` lists them, and `/v1/systemone` answers `typesafe/jev-*` or `@judge` instead of 404, or 422 from a chat model ([#18740](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18740) by [@andyhite](https://github.com/andyhite))
- `omp auth-gateway stdio` no longer cuts its last responses off at 128 KiB when its input ends before a slow reader has read them ([#18740](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18740) by [@andyhite](https://github.com/andyhite))
- `omp --session <id> --restore` restores that session, as `omp --restore --session <id>` does, instead of opening the session picker: a bare `--restore` keeps a session `--session` or `--resume` already named ([#18685](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18685) by [@AdamDureyAtWillship](https://github.com/AdamDureyAtWillship))
- The legacy Pi virtual module now builds in an npm install that keeps the bundled Pi packages nested: it is anchored to the installed package, so its imports resolve through that package's own dependency graph ([#15208](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15208), [#18733](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18733) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- User-level agents, commands, and other `~/.omp/agent` config (including agents saved from the agents hub) now follow `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`, matching where `omp agents unpack` writes ([#18684](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18684))
- Fixed `grep` and `glob` treating a `;` list that starts with an internal URL and includes a local path, such as `artifact://1;notes.txt`, as one address; each listed target is now searched ([#18714](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18714) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Isolated tasks that edit a file whose name contains spaces now commit that file, including in a nested git repository, instead of leaving it unstaged or committing a different file that shares part of the name ([#18715](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18715) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- A disposed or switched session now releases every persistent shell it owns, including the ones a surface keeps under a name of its own (`/loop` conditions), instead of holding one native shell per surface for the life of the process ([#18717](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18717) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))

## @oh-my-pi/collab-web

### Changed

- Ask result cards render saved notes beneath their matching selected answers ([#18779](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18779) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Changed

- macOS keys, typing and held keys for a window now go to a sheet attached to it that holds keyboard focus, such as an Open sheet or Finder's Go to Folder, as macOS sends them, instead of throwing `InvalidTarget` and naming the sheet; so do keys for a control of that sheet, which reports the window under it as its own ([#18675](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18675) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Computer input no longer fails with `InputBusy` the moment another omp session's call holds the desktop, such as an `apps.open` waiting for its window: it waits up to 5 seconds for that call to finish, on macOS, Linux and Windows ([#18746](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18746) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed a crash when parsing Markdown with very deeply nested lists or block quotes, such as a line of several hundred `- ` markers, which made editing such files kill the process ([#18707](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18707))
- Fixed the shell's `git` builtin on Windows with `bash.gitGuard` (or smart git) on failing every allowed command with exit 127 (`…\Git\cmd\git: No such file or directory`); it now runs `git.exe` ([#18722](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18722))
- Computer element searches accept native role names, spaced role names such as `text field`, and `radiobutton` for macOS `radio` controls without changing printed accessibility roles ([#18745](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18745) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background input and takeover refusing every call, with nothing sent, while Finder is in front with its focus on the desktop and a Finder window open; Finder gets its front status back with its focus left on the desktop ([#18680](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18680) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Changed

- Ask forms support notes on options: `n` on radio/checkbox rows and `Alt+n` on select menus (`app.ask.note`), with selected notes shown alongside submitted answers and notes on unchosen options marked as drafts ([#18779](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18779) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))

### Fixed

- Ask form textareas edited from Tern now restart the inactivity timeout instead of submitting mid-edit
- Fixed a picture in an `ask` form staying painted on screen after the form closed ([#18693](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18693) by [@jaredlyon](https://github.com/jaredlyon))
- Fixed terminal Device Attributes replies (such as `^[[?64;1;2;4;6;17;18;21;22c`) leaking into the shell prompt on exit ([#18662](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18662) by [@asuffield](https://github.com/asuffield))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Removed

- Removed `getConfigAgentDirName()`; use `getAgentDir()`, which also honors `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` ([#18684](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18684))


## What's Changed
* fix(natives): send macOS keys for a window to the sheet focused on it by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18675
* fix(bash): release session-owned namespaced shells by @eggpeat in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18717
* fix(ai,coding-agent): deliver assistant_message rewrites through Codex native replay by @holny in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18720

name: v18.18.7
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- LiteLLM usage adapter (`@oh-my-pi/pi-ai/usage/litellm`) reporting a gateway's key and user USD budgets ([#17873](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17873) by [@maykonmichel](https://github.com/maykonmichel))
- `UsageApi.replaceConfiguredProviders` registers configuration-sourced usage providers between runtime overrides and the built-in resolver, and `UsageProvider.usesRequestKey` makes aggregate usage probe only the key inference would send ([#17873](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17873) by [@maykonmichel](https://github.com/maykonmichel))

### Changed

- Providers with a `login-warning` auth rule show their account risk before a new login and start it only after the user answers `yes`; any other answer or a cancel stores nothing, and their login-list entry is marked "(at your own risk)" ([#18499](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18499))

### Fixed

- Claude Fable launch resets now report the Fable weekly limit they clear instead of an unknown window ([#18661](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18661) by [@TheAifam5](https://github.com/TheAifam5))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added Muse Ember (`muse-ember-1.0`) on Meta Model API and Muse Code with the `minimal`–`max` reasoning effort ladder and its >200K long-context pricing
- Added the `login-warning "<text>"` auth rule, which makes a new login accept the stated account risk first ([#18499](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18499))

### Changed

- Resumed Google Antigravity behind a login warning instead of pausing it ([#18499](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18499))

### Fixed

- Morph (`api.morphllm.com`) requests now send `x-session-id`, keeping a conversation on the worker that holds its prompt cache ([#18704](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18704) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- `/usage` and `omp usage` show LiteLLM key and user budgets for the built-in `litellm` provider and every models.yml provider with `discovery.type: litellm`, unless listed in `disabledProviders` ([#17873](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17873) by [@maykonmichel](https://github.com/maykonmichel))
- Extensions can ask the operator before an interactive quit, or cancel it, with `session_before_shutdown`; a further `/exit` or Ctrl+D skips the pending prompts and closes ([#18424](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18424) by [@aw1cks](https://github.com/aw1cks))

### Changed

- Saved-reset auto-redeem is set per window: `codexResets.autoRedeem5h`/`autoRedeemWeekly` and `claudeResets.autoRedeem5h`/`autoRedeemWeekly`/`autoRedeemFable` replace each provider's `autoRedeem`, whose value migrates into the 5h and weekly keys; a Claude Fable launch reset is governed by `autoRedeemFable` alone and spent only for a block that includes the Fable weekly cap, or before expiry when Fable usage is above zero ([#18661](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18661) by [@TheAifam5](https://github.com/TheAifam5))
- Sessions without a prompt UI (such as `omp -p`) no longer spend saved resets while auto-redeem is `unset`, even ones about to expire ([#18661](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18661))
- Google Antigravity is back in `/login` and `omp login`, marked "(at your own risk)": a new login first explains that Google may suspend accounts that sign in from third-party tools and continues only after you type `yes`; saved Antigravity logins work again ([#18499](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/18499))
- On Windows, the bash tool's description tells the model it runs in an emulated bash environment, not cmd or PowerShell, so it writes bash instead of `dir`, `%VAR%` and other cmd syntax

### Fixed

- Extension prompts shown from `session_before_*` handlers no longer time out after 30 seconds while the operator is still answering ([#18424](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18424) by [@aw1cks](https://github.com/aw1cks))
- A second exit request now skips pending `worktree.onExit` prompts and keeps those worktrees instead of waiting for an answer ([#18424](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18424) by [@aw1cks](https://github.com/aw1cks))
- Advice that makes the agent keep working after it finished no longer comes back a second time, often as a blocker, while the agent is fixing it: advisor reviews of the earlier answer are cancelled and the advisor reviews the fix instead ([#18735](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18735) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- On Windows, the bash tool's shell resolves MSYS drive paths (`/c/Users/...`, `/mnt/c/...`) everywhere, so running `/c/.../tool.exe`, `cd /c/...`, `[ -f /c/... ]` and `< /c/...` reach drive C: like they already did for `ls` and other built-in utilities
- On Windows, cmd-style command lines such as `dir | find /c /v ""`, `sort /r`, `timeout /t 5` and `whoami /all` in the bash tool run the Windows programs they were written for, instead of pi's GNU-style `find`/`sort`/`timeout`/`whoami` (which read `/c` as drive C: and could walk the whole drive)
- Changing or unsetting `PATH` in the bash tool's shell now forgets remembered command locations, as bash does, so a command no longer runs from a directory that has left `PATH`
- One slow or flooding collab guest no longer ends sharing for the room: the host drops that guest's backlog and asks it to rejoin, sessions larger than the send budget can be joined, and guest questions nobody received settle as unavailable ([#18629](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18629) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Changed

- `grep` and `ast_grep` results with no matches render as one line with `0 matches` in the warning color, dropping the separate `No matches found` row ([#18700](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18700) by [@JustasMasiulis](https://github.com/JustasMasiulis))

### Fixed

- Saved-reset messages name the Claude Fable weekly limit as "Claude Fable weekly" instead of its raw id ([#18661](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18661) by [@TheAifam5](https://github.com/TheAifam5))


## What's Changed
* feat(extensions): add an interactive pre-shutdown hook by @aw1cks in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18424
* fix(tui): show grep's 0 matches in yellow on one line by @JustasMasiulis in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18700
* fix(shell): resolve MSYS drive paths (/c/...) in the engine on Windows by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18703
* fix(catalog): pin Morph conversations to one worker with x-session-id by @wolfiesch in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18704
* fix(shell): run cmd-syntax command lines through the Windows programs pi's utilities shadow by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18711
* feat(coding-agent): split saved-reset auto-redeem into 5h, weekly and Claude Fable settings by @TheAifam5 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18661
* fix(advisor): stop superseded reviews from re-raising advice the primary is already fixing by @H4vC in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18735
* fix(collab): keep one guest from ending sharing for the room by @iliaal in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18629
* feat(ai): report LiteLLM key/user budgets in /usage and omp usage by @maykonmichel in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17873

## New Contributors
* @TheAifam5 made their first contribution in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/18661

name: Reasonix Studio v2.60.0
body:
本版让内置浏览器可以点选页面元素并把修改直接存回本地网页，会话之间的消息不再需要批准，工作台可并排显示文件树。

## 新增

- 内置浏览器新增「点选页面元素」：点一下页面上的元素，就能看到它的选择器、文字和颜色 (6c9c6851a)
- 从工作区本地文件打开的网页，可以直接改所选元素的文字、文字颜色、背景色和字号，并保存回文件；文件源码里对不上的元素会说明原因，不会写入 (6c9c6851a)
- 工作台在打开的文件旁边显示文件树 (2ff95dbc5)

## 变更

- 「让模型把任务交给其他会话」开关打开时（默认开启），你自己的其他会话发来的消息直接交给模型，不再出现批准卡；关闭开关则仍需批准 (4dc2b1938)
- 保存会话时不再为每条消息复制一份数据，长会话的保存更快、占用更少内存 (e19fc12a5)

## 升级须知

- 会话间消息默认不再需要批准：同机其他会话写进消息目录的内容，会在开关打开时直接进入模型；不想要请在设置的「会话间消息」里关闭派发开关 (4dc2b1938)

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## New

- The built-in browser can pick an element on the page: click it to see its selector, text and colors (6c9c6851a)
- On a page opened from a workspace file, the picked element's text, text color, background and size can be changed and saved back to the file; an element the file's source cannot place is refused with the reason and nothing is written (6c9c6851a)
- The workbench shows the file tree beside the open file (2ff95dbc5)

## Changed

- While the switch that lets the model hand tasks to other sessions is on (the default), a message from your other sessions reaches the model without an approval card; with the switch off it still waits for approval (4dc2b1938)
- Saving a session no longer copies every message, so long sessions save faster and use less memory (e19fc12a5)

## Upgrade notes

- Messages between sessions no longer need approval by default: anything another session on this machine writes to the message directory goes straight to the model while the switch is on; turn the dispatch switch off under Messages between sessions in Settings to keep the card (4dc2b1938)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.59.0...studio-v2.60.0


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: v0.5.8-beta.4 — VoiceStudio
body:
### Installer signing

| Platform | Signing |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| macOS (Intel) | ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple |
| Windows x64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Windows ARM64 | ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway |
| Linux x64 | — Linux packages are not code-signed |

### Phone downloads

Android: [signed APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-android.apk) · [Play bundle](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-android.aab).

iPhone: [unsigned sideload IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-ios-unsigned.ipa). Sign with your own Apple ID to install; this is not a TestFlight build.

**AMD and Intel GPUs now speed up OmniVoice, and setup gets far more forgiving.** OmniVoice GGUF runs on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan on Windows and Linux, dots.tts arrives on Windows with no Python setup, and a failing PyTorch download or a broken GPU no longer leaves you without a working app.

**New since beta.3:** audio.cpp v0.9.4, hardware video encoders for dub exports, the Ming-3.0-tts and MOSS-SoundEffect engines, a `voicestudio` terminal command, streaming OpenAI-compatible speech, Windows ROCm for RDNA 1 and 2 GPUs, per-voice pronunciation dictionaries, Convert voice for video, source-language dubbing, a lighter startup, a tidier setup screen and account page, and dozens of dubbing, setup, Snap and Android fixes.

**Testing wanted:** these get their first real-hardware test in this beta, so reports are welcome: the audio.cpp v0.9.4 runtime, hardware video encoders for dub exports, the Ming-3.0-tts engine, sound effects (MOSS-SoundEffect, NVIDIA GPUs only), the Snap fixes and the Windows uninstall prompt that offers to delete downloaded models. OmniVoice GGUF resident mode is opt-in and inactive until a build ships the `tts-server` binary.

**Download**

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-win-x64.exe) |
| Windows ARM64 (experimental) | [Installer](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-win-arm64.exe) |
| macOS Apple Silicon | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| macOS Intel | [DMG](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-mac-x64.dmg) |
| Linux x64 | [AppImage](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-linux-x64.AppImage) · [deb](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-linux-x64.deb) |
| Android | [APK](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-android.apk) · [AAB](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-android.aab) |
| iPhone | [Unsigned IPA](https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio/releases/download/v0.5.8-beta.4/VoiceStudio-0.5.8-beta.4-ios-unsigned.ipa) (sideload with your own Apple ID) |

**Upgrading:** Install over your existing app; voices, projects and settings are kept.

**Highlights**

- OmniVoice GGUF uses AMD, Intel and NVIDIA GPUs through Vulkan on Windows and Linux
- dots.tts voice cloning now runs on Windows through audio.cpp, with no Python setup
- Convert can keep your delivery, changing only the voice
- Dubbing exports subtitles before dubbing and moves lines between speakers
- Setup falls back to the CPU build when PyTorch downloads fail, and the app falls back to the CPU when the GPU fails


### Changed

- The backend starts lighter and faster: speech-recognition engines are checked in a short-lived helper process instead of being loaded at startup, while broken installs are still reported as unavailable (#3924, #3946)
- The app opens with less code to load: the audio and video players load with the first clip played and returning users skip the first-run setup screens, cutting the startup bundle by about 6%, and a new offline benchmark with a CI check on bundle growth tracks startup, memory, CPU and bundle size (#3924, #3940, #3943)
- Settings → VoiceStudio account lists what to sync and your devices as compact, aligned rows with icons, a Pro badge with one Get Pro link for locked items, and device rows that show OS and when each was last active (#3937)
- The runtime setup screen fits one window: one status line, the install folder with free space, one main action (or the exact fix, such as choosing another folder when the drive is full), with language, region, Python and remote options under Options and recovery tools under More fixes (#3934)
- OmniVoice GGUF can keep its runtime loaded between requests to skip the reload before each generation, as an opt-in under Settings → Performance; it stays inactive until a build ships omnivoice.cpp's `tts-server`, so nothing changes today (#3965, #3654)
- The audio.cpp runtime updates to v0.9.4; installed Breeze-TTS-2, dots.tts and Sortformer models keep working without a re-download, and the previous runtime keeps running them until you install the update (#3129)
- Updates now download in the background and install when you quit, with a compact title-bar pill for progress, Restart and Retry, clearer error messages and a restart prompt when work is running (#3928)
- The top bar is more compact: the account button is just your profile photo, or a person icon when signed out, and the GitHub star count is shortened (#3922).
- Product analytics moved from PostHog to Supermetry, still only after a yes at the first-run prompt, and now also records which engine ran each generation and transcription. (#3902)
- Restyled Settings → VoiceStudio account to match the home page: one account card with your plan and storage, the email shown once, and a storage bar visible at 0%. (#3885)
- Account sign-in is available in every build, still off until you turn it on, and now starts on the VoiceStudio dashboard with a separate Sign up option (#3850)
- The Pro page in the app now shows the correct $199 Lifetime price (#3831)
- Mac releases use an Apple API key for notarization instead of an account password. (#3775) — thanks @velixio!
- Source development now prepares the local API environment before launching Electron (#3637)
- Remove obsolete screenshot and source-archive helpers that targeted the retired UI layout. (#3623)
- Removed unused development tools (pytest-cov, Turborepo and a duplicate TypeScript) from the repository and fixed the remaining broken documentation links (#3571, #2603, #2903) — thanks @themrbeasley and @marciok!
- Workflows open at /workflows framed to their steps, Calls opens at /calls, and an unknown address shows Page not found (#3547)
- Projects lists projects under All projects with voices, transcripts, takes and exports grouped under Library; saving a dub now lives in Dubbing (#3547)
- The OmniVoice sidecar availability check no longer imports the model, so backend startup reconcile finishes about 6 s sooner (#3534) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- The first-run install screen is cleaner: one progress bar, a step checklist that shows the package being installed, and Cancel and the log inside the progress card (#3534) — thanks @meisolated!

### Added

- Qwen Base can deliver audio during generation on the speech WebSocket (#3992) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- OpenAI-compatible PCM speech can stream during synthesis, with native Qwen3-TTS Base support on Apple Silicon and provisioned NVIDIA systems (#3976) — thanks @kellerkind84!
- The account menu in the window corner shows your profile photo, email, plan and cloud storage, with a Manage plan link (#3955)
- The VoiceStudio account card has a larger avatar that opens your profile page to change the photo, an inline display-name editor, a plan badge with icon, an iconized storage meter, and icon buttons for refresh and sign out (#3948)
- Pronunciation dictionaries can now belong to a single voice: switch the pronunciation settings to This voice and its entries win over the language dictionary whenever that voice speaks (#3873)
- New `voicestudio` terminal command: use voices, speech, transcription, dubbing and models from your terminal, with VoiceStudio starting in the background when needed, plus Tab completion (#3828) — thanks @mostafa-ismail-2004!
- An OpenAI-compatible LLM provider with an API key can now use plain HTTP on a trusted LAN IP address, through a new per-provider opt-in that is off by default (#3811)

- Dubbed lines now start on detected speech, so a sigh, breath or footstep before a line no longer makes it start early, and trailing breaths no longer pad its slot (#3573, #3419)
- VoxCPM2 generates again on NVIDIA GPUs when it runs in the main engine, instead of failing every time with a CUDA graph assertion (#3571, #3567) — thanks @Fguarien!
- The OmniVoice GGUF engine now works out of the box: Windows, Apple Silicon and Linux installers ship its native runtime (#3569, #2780) — thanks @DestinyQJY and @chiarorosa!
- OmniVoice on an older NVIDIA GPU that the installed PyTorch has no kernels for now shows as running on the CPU and gets the CPU time allowance, so slow renders are not cut short (#3565, #3067)
- When Windows Smart App Control, an application control policy or an antivirus blocks one of the engine's files, the error names the blocker and VoiceStudio no longer re-downloads the runtime (#3557, #3209, #3224) — thanks @ark2006aug13-byte and @pauloerv-sketch!
- First-run setup downloads large wheels such as the Windows CUDA `torch` over several connections and resumes them after Cancel or Retry, instead of crawling at about 1 MB/s on networks that limit each connection (#3557, #3411, #3060, #3202) — thanks @justcallme-A and @hadialshaer!
- The app no longer crashes with an "insertBefore" error when browser page translation or an extension changes the page (#3555, #3168) — thanks @wwwfelipe29-ai!
- An engine install that needs a C++ compiler, such as CosyVoice 3, now says which build tools to install instead of blaming the network (#3553, #3423)
- Switching Linux to the AMD ROCm build of PyTorch finishes setup instead of failing on a Pillow version conflict (#3553, #3158) — thanks @Blade-pt and @prashker!
- Older NVIDIA GPUs that the installed PyTorch has no kernels for (such as Maxwell cards) now show as running on the CPU instead of "CUDA ready" (#3553, #3067) — thanks @BheeshamKS!
- Voice cloning on Mac no longer fails with "couldn't synthesize audio" after a clone without reference text (#3552, #3551) — thanks @macfluryy!
- Opening Calls after visiting Integrations no longer crashes the Calls page (#3550)
- Gallery switches sections in the page header, Community gains search and lists each voice once, and the saved-voice list highlights only the current voice (#3547)
- The navigation keeps one layout on every page, the bottom player no longer covers the nav rail, and the Pro page header clears the account corner (#3547)
- Command search finds pages by short names such as clone, models, integrations, pro and dark, and lists recent takes once with their age and length (#3547)
- Script samples and placeholders in every language show literal [pause 0.5s] and [voice:NAME] markup, and uncast characters get one calm note instead of warnings (#3547)
- Interrupted Stories and Audiobook renders show once per project on their own page, explain a disabled Resume, and can be dismissed (#3547)
- Every workspace shows the same not-ready notice with one Set up action, and disabled buttons now say why (#3547)
- Audiobook and Dubbing stay usable in short windows: the script editor and segment list keep their room, and find, stage and readiness notes share one slim strip (#3547)
- The Hearth light theme uses a non-red colour for primary buttons, keeping red for destructive actions (#3546)
- Settings opens on General, page names match their contents, and the breadcrumb shows the model family (#3546)
- Settings → Credentials has one Save per translation provider, and Settings Save buttons enable only after a change (#3546)
- Model rows name their licence type, show sizes in one unit style, and drop the duplicate Selected button (#3546)
- Performance presets no longer switch Apple Silicon transcription from MLX to CPU Faster-Whisper (#3546)
- Model packs preselect the largest pack that fits your free disk space instead of Max (#3546)
- Settings → Storage shows one low-disk warning, and the disk bar turns amber or red when nearly full (#3546)
- Settings search lists only matching pages and finds Theme by "dark" or "light" and model families by name (#3546)
- Settings → Usage no longer says VoiceStudio has no analytics; optional analytics is controlled in Privacy (#3546)
- Settings → Updates "What's new" shows formatted release notes instead of raw markdown tables and links (#3546)
- Job progress history repairs duplicate event numbers so replayed progress never skips or repeats a step (#3542) — thanks @sedatdagg!
- Long transcriptions no longer repeat themselves, and the transcription model stays loaded between requests (#3542) — thanks @gifmac!
- The OmniVoice GGUF runtime builds for every x86-64 CPU, and a runtime that hits an illegal instruction is reported clearly (#3542) — thanks @inteligencia66!
- Streamed generations and long-form renders stay connected behind proxies such as Cloudflare while a slow chunk or chapter renders (#3542) — thanks @fouadSalkini!
- `bun run start` and `bun run preview` launch the desktop app again on a fresh checkout (#3542) — thanks @inteligencia66!
- Turning off Tailscale sharing removes only VoiceStudio's own share and never resets other apps' Tailscale serve settings (#3542) — thanks @hiiqbiz-wq!
- Saved Voice Design profiles preserve natural-language prompts across reopening, previewing, and portable export/import (#3541) — thanks @XiaoPuOuO!
- Audiobook and Stories renders keep cached chapters during overlapping resumes, stay responsive while preparing the cache, and remove incomplete outputs when assembly fails or is cancelled (#3540) — thanks @Bortlesboat!
- GPU acceleration report names a card the installed PyTorch build has no kernels for, instead of reporting a CUDA start that would work and pointing at a driver update that cannot add them (#3540) — thanks @Faisal-Fayaz!
- Long text between `[pause]` markers is split into sentence chunks like unmarked text, so a long passage next to a pause no longer degrades into garbled audio (#3540) — thanks @maatitechnologies-hue!
- Long Urdu, Persian, Arabic and Hindi scripts split at sentence ends and clause marks instead of mid-sentence, even with no space after the mark (#3540) — thanks @maatitechnologies-hue!
- File transcription no longer cancels when you leave the Transcribe page; the result is saved and a toast links back to it (#3535) — thanks @adrianchen91!
- The dubbing timeline stays visible when a transcript cue is selected, including in long transcripts and compact windows (#3535) — thanks @BichengWang!
- MLX-Audio OuteTTS voice cloning reads the reference clip with a Whisper model installed from Model Catalogue instead of hanging on a download, and reuses the voice on later generations (#3535) — thanks @kevin9327 for the fix and @unovlad for the report!
- Space-grouped thousands like 1 234 or 10 000 keep their digits in French, German, Russian and other comma-decimal languages (#3535) — thanks @NishchayMahor!
- Bug reports now redact a nonstandard home folder even when punctuation follows it (#3534) — thanks @zichen0116!
- Updated DOMPurify and proxy-addr to versions that fix published security advisories (#3534) — thanks @anupamme!
- Voice Cloning sends manually entered reference transcripts with saved voices instead of dropping them before synthesis (#3534) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Convert no longer reads short non-Latin clips (e.g. Armenian) as the wrong language: pick the source language, or it follows the target voice's language (#3534) — thanks @YuraZakaryan!
- Desktop releases now include Android and iPhone sideload downloads from the same version, without Apple signing blocking the iPhone file (#3516)
- Prevent reset and uninstall cleanup from deleting data through lookalike or linked folders. (#3512)
- Error banners show diagnosed problems in your language with a button that fixes them, such as installing a speech-to-text model, freeing memory or opening Storage (#3511)
- A running Story or Audiobook render stays visible after you leave its page: the other book page and the notifications bell show its progress with Show progress and Stop, and interrupted Stories renders can be resumed (#3510)
- Source checkouts with a missing Python environment get Retry instead of a folder picker that could not work, and installed apps never show the developer setup command (#3508)
- A finished runtime setup no longer offers "Resume interrupted download", and Resume reuses the existing environment and download cache instead of fetching PyTorch again (#3508)
- Windows runtime refreshes retry and update files in place when OneDrive, antivirus or a running backend locks them, and a lasting lock now says which program to close (#3507)
- Windows setup that crashed with exit code 3221225477 on an outdated Visual C++ runtime now names the cause and tells you to update the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (#3507)
- Russian labels read naturally in Export, Audiobook, About and seed controls (RAM, stems, cover, seed) (#3479) — thanks @al2m!
- Caption imports keep ruby base words without speaking pronunciation guides or losing later cues (#3360) — thanks @014-code!
- Percentages now speak the trailing zeros that were written, so 2.50% is two point five zero percent (#3359) — thanks @kevin9327!
- On Apple Silicon, the Quality and Max model packs install and use Whisper on the GPU (MLX) instead of a CPU-only copy (#3349) — thanks @bee-interactive!
- Locking a take keeps its whole text as the voice's reference transcript, instead of cutting it at 100 characters (#3320) — thanks @bercedev!
- Markdown bold and italic markers are stripped before synthesis instead of being read aloud as "asterisk" (#3197, #3205) — thanks @swadhinbiswas!
- Cmd/Ctrl+Z in a Dub page field such as the glossary, translation notes or a segment's Start/End now undoes your typing there instead of the last transcript edit, and Cmd/Ctrl+S on a timeline segment no longer snaps it to the nearest onset (#3199) — thanks @HEOJUNFO!
- MOSS-TTS-Nano reuses the configured tokenizer cache instead of nesting another cache inside its model code and exceeding Windows path limits (#3137, #3167) — thanks @ZFzuofeng!
- Startup no longer loads unused OmniVoice weights when another speech engine is selected (#3127) — thanks @isnaenihidayat!
- Smart Fit keeps overlapping speakers and captions on one timeline without replaying shared video (#3008) — thanks @jonathanwxh-cell!
- Dubbing segment Start and End fields no longer round the time when you tab through them without typing (#2986) — thanks @HEOJUNFO!
- Model downloads show honest overall progress instead of a bar that jumps backwards or under-reports while several files are in flight (#2936, #2952) — thanks @DeryFerd!
- Local marketplace installs keep designed voices and their saved design settings (#2878) — thanks @agammann!
- CosyVoice's one-click install now resolves on Linux ARM64, with or without an NVIDIA GPU (#2830) — thanks @Jason69628723!
- The macOS menu-bar icon now uses a correctly sized monochrome glyph that follows the system appearance (#2750, #2828) — thanks @Fredy002 and @windery!
- On macOS, the app icon is no longer oversized in the Dock, Launchpad and Finder (#2744, #2749) — thanks @windery!
- Intel Arc (XPU) GPUs load models on Windows and recover from out-of-memory errors instead of failing every later request until a restart (#2747) — thanks @nur-zaman!
- Settings → System reports an Ascend NPU host's device name and VRAM, and the memory-flush snapshot reads the NPU and Intel XPU (#2582) — thanks @li-lizhe!

### License

- Korean and a few other interface strings, the pronunciation list's "not applied yet" badge and Malayalam number reading that still came from contributions without a signed CLA are rewritten from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3613)
- A copied test helper that still matched an earlier contribution without a signed CLA is rewritten from scratch (#3607)
- The last few code passages and docstrings that still resembled earlier contributions without a signed CLA are reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3606)
- One more test that matched an earlier contribution without a signed CLA is rewritten from scratch (#3601)
- The remaining code, tests and docs that still matched earlier contributions without a signed CLA are reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3596)
- The proxy keepalive for streamed generation and a few English interface strings that still came from earlier contributions without a signed CLA are reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3591)
- Sherpa-ONNX Piper voice loading, the pyannote audio adapter, native dictation start/stop handling and a few smaller pieces that still came from earlier contributions without a signed CLA are reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3587)
- Korean and Simplified Chinese translations that still came from earlier contributions without a signed CLA are retranslated from scratch, with no change to keys or behaviour (#3586)
- The last English strings and tests from earlier contributions without a signed CLA are reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3580)
- More code and translations from earlier contributions without a signed CLA are reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3578)
- More code from earlier contributions without a signed CLA is reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3564)
- Code from earlier contributions without a signed CLA is reimplemented from scratch, with no change in behaviour (#3563)

### CI

- The iOS UI smoke suite waits for every screen and control on slow runners and retries a failed test once, so it no longer fails at random (#3982)
- Pull requests wait as drafts with heavy CI skipped until their opener signs the CLA, which now has a 3-day deadline, and a new agent guide helps AI-assisted pull requests arrive merge-ready (#3974)
- The UI crawler waits for lazily loaded code before leaving a screen, and dev servers no longer send /api-reference pages to the backend, fixing a recurring CI flake (#3952)
- CI skips heavy jobs whose exact inputs already passed, and merge-queue runs skip the Electron jobs a change cannot affect (#3933)
- Main-process tests now run on macOS and Windows for every pull request, so platform-specific failures surface before a release (#3927)
- Releases are refused if they carry another channel's update feed, and publishing checks that a beta never becomes the latest release. (#3898)
- CI actions updated: setup-node 7, setup-java 6, deploy-pages 5, CodeQL 4.39.3 everywhere, Vulkan SDK and Docker login actions. (#3893, #3894, #3895, #3896, #3897)
- Release builds retry macOS packaging when Apple's notarization service drops a connection, instead of failing the release. (#3889)
- CI finishes sooner: Python tests run on 6 workers, Electron renderer tests reuse their test environment, and the UI crawler and accessibility smoke wait on real page readiness instead of fixed delays (#3874)
- The iOS keyboard test no longer fails on a slow CI simulator after the keyboard is already gone (#3864) — thanks @velixio!
- Desktop release tag builds no longer stop at startup when they call the phone release workflow (#3860)
- Updated the Vite+ build and test toolchain to 1.5, clearing published dev-server advisories (#3858)
- Read release notes and test fixtures as UTF-8 on Windows (#3766) — thanks @Bl0ck154!
- Refresh the pinned Docker login action used to publish container images (#3761)
- Refresh the pinned checkout action used by CI and release workflows (#3760)
- Refresh the pinned Docker Buildx action used to build container images (#3759)
- Refresh the pinned Python setup action used by CI (#3758)
- Refresh the pinned Gradle setup action used by Android workflows (#3757)
- The iOS on-device speech test no longer fails when the small speech recognizer hears a generated "Hi" as "High" (#3852)
- The CLA comment now links each signer's permanent signature record instead of an older pull request (#3842)
- Pull requests with signed CLAs now get the `cla-signed` label and a comment linking the agreement and signatures automatically (#3840)
- Retry the Android NDK and CMake install in CI when a download comes back corrupt (#3812)
- Publish fork Docker images and registry caches under the repository owner namespace on GHCR (#3795)
- Stabilize iOS UI checks for keyboard dismissal and gallery preset navigation. (#3746)
- Run Apple Silicon smoke checks and native dependency builds on maintained macOS 15 runners. (#3736)
- Reuse the existing iOS archive signing identity and keep camera hardware optional for Android store installs. (#3729)
- Android Play builds prepare native runtimes and verify self-signed upload keys before internal testing (#3725)
- Wait for the iOS keyboard Done control to become hittable before tapping it in smoke tests. (#3646)
- Validate data relocation, engine setup and preset controls together against current main (#3644)
- Disable CodeRabbit finishing-touch repair prompts on pull requests (#3641)
- Stabilize iOS test readiness and cold-build validation, and cover ROCm recovery and batch-language interaction. (#3634)
- Four renderer smoke tests run in CI again after a test-helper move hid them from the smoke inventory (#3600)
- The broken-link check covers CHANGELOG.md and SPONSORS.md, so a rotted link on a repository-root page fails the suite instead of going unnoticed (#3572) — thanks @AliAladraj!
- The Linux GGUF runtime build no longer runs out of memory on CI runners (#3569, #2780)
- Snapcraft Builds can package VoiceStudio from the published release (#3545)
- The iOS Home UI test reliably opens every Home card again instead of flicking cards out of view (#3543)
- The Python test suite no longer aborts on Windows when bun was installed through npm (#3534) — thanks @shubhankarkanase90-byte!
- Pull requests with a changelog fragment pass the changelog check again after a release (#3517)
- Snap Store listing banner, bundled and size-checked with the other Snap listing assets (#3514)
- iOS Home UI tests no longer break when the contributor list is reordered or a card sits under the navigation bar, building on the first fix in #3481 (#3509) — thanks @XiaoPuOuO!
- The Electron unit tests run on Node 25+ and Homebrew Node without extra flags (#3469) — thanks @BichengWang!
- The backend registry test expects the OmniVoice sidecar on Apple Silicon, so it passes on every host (#2697) — thanks @rollroyces!

### Contributors

New since v0.5.8-beta.3: @debpalash, @kellerkind84, @meosbrand, @mostafa-ismail-2004, @eaves-dropper, @sdf123098, @dutch2005, @isnaenihidayat, @kevin9327, @hkarmoush, @samay-hash, @velixio, @EriconYu

Everyone who contributed since v0.5.7: @debpalash, @velixio, @rudycelekli, @kellerkind84, @RerankerGuo, @adrianchen91, @EriconYu, @sidmax7, @meosbrand, @dutch2005, @kevin9327, @hkarmoush, @isnaenihidayat, @swadhinbiswas, @teehihi, @ColinCee, @swax, @XiaoPuOuO, @mostafa-ismail-2004, @DeryFerd, @eaves-dropper, @sdf123098, @maatitechnologies-hue, @Thakay, @Bortlesboat, @DPhngNam, @HEOJUNFO, @InesZenkri, @lucassmonn, @meutex, @Aksel103, @Bl0ck154, @filip-gooddata, @meisolated, @mertkayacs, @samay-hash, @AliAladraj, @BichengWang, @Faisal-Fayaz, @jonathanwxh-cell, @mvanhorn, @NishchayMahor, @vandyahmad24, @vanshsingh3711-wq, @YuraZakaryan, @014-code, @agammann, @ai-v99, @al2m, @amhanesipeace, @B1NAR10, @bee-interactive, @bercedev, @DennyHo0917, @esdedev, @Felixkw12, @Fredy002, @HyperionBurn, @IvanGrigin, @Jason69628723, @li-lizhe, @nur-zaman, @rollroyces, @sebas-rodri, @shamil2, @vincentfranstyo, @windery, @writer0713, @ZFzuofeng

body:
## [1.13.0](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/compare/chrome-devtools-mcp-v1.12.0...chrome-devtools-mcp-v1.13.0) (2026-11-11)


### 🎉 Features

* add logpoints built on the DevTools BreakpointManager ([#3211](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3211)) ([0877ee0](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/0877ee00d2e43c1c04bba275e7d08cc1033e36e9))
* add page-scoped network mocks ([#3384](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3384)) ([1d692d3](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/1d692d31ae370105afcf4d826dc36f1c4c22e21a))
* support upstream network mock responses ([#3420](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3420)) ([c4bf342](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/c4bf342b0854620d2e41262a971e1b24b705f957))


### 🛠️ Fixes

* **config:** accept config files with a UTF-8 BOM ([#3365](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3365)) ([63170b1](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/63170b11a2fa74d5ceea757194d7b25f3e145f68))
* **console:** stop resolving a cyclic Error.cause chain after 10 causes ([#3338](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3338)) ([172656a](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/172656ab38a4ff666f88dc9032fa841834a69495))
* disable set_logpoints when --no-javascript-evaluation is set ([#3415](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3415)) ([11fcc59](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/11fcc596290eb73658a3afad89afc037595172e5)), closes [#3414](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3414)
* **extensions:** say list_extensions only lists unpacked extensions ([#3433](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3433)) ([1383bb9](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/1383bb9b4145227976e49a5dd010aa105b638e44))
* ignore an invalid cached version in the update check ([#3392](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3392)) ([3a9f378](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/3a9f3780d23a765ed0125d139338d41d311701c0))
* **input:** validate press_key and submitKey parameters in Zod schema ([#3382](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3382)) ([375a269](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/375a269ee0905a8a30bd15827e701bc1a94d9d9e))
* **network:** start an empty request list for navigations without a request ([#3357](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3357)) ([b701776](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/b7017767a4b230509670a27ffee20a8255e3554f))
* normalize non-Error values thrown by tool handlers ([#3068](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3068)) ([535a3dc](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/535a3dc619498240e25a4ab1b9d9ed37a68579ad))
* **performance:** error when performance_stop_trace is called on a non-recording page ([#2971](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/2971)) ([#3117](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3117)) ([1ab630a](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/1ab630aecc558ba1626851982cdec13f7c4659f6))
* **plugin:** launch the Claude Code MCP server with npx --prefix ([#3353](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3353)) ([a24334d](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/a24334d3a1733996438c3c4786ab4f880aaaf044))
* preserve task serialization on request cancellation ([#3079](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3079)) ([03fd4e8](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/03fd4e840c6afc8b86f1d2dd9d94b41dcff8a326))
* report page loads that keep the URL ([#3395](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3395)) ([3cc38bb](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/3cc38bb3640a7f3c4a24f10258b44f5a5ae808a3))
* save binary request bodies byte for byte ([#3404](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3404)) ([e3eb901](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/e3eb901fcc1de3a3cbf1be39d22e0d306a0ae23d))
* suggest --headless when Chrome cannot find an X server ([#3428](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3428)) ([8b0856a](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/8b0856ad3f403fb560159eec563365632f5d0e58))
* **url:** unwrap view-source: before all scheme checks in validateUrl ([#3335](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3335)) ([7275268](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/7275268bf05258d8cff8d18ace79848adbf27cac))
* **wait:** explain whitespace-sensitive text matching ([#3350](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3350)) ([81a0379](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/81a037939b19a3588ac6a35e06d576af706a3b57))


### 📄 Documentation

* add Pi client configuration ([#3364](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3364)) ([bc0d93e](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/bc0d93ee2df6f2410d9e9704903c3547acae7c9a))
* clarify custom browser launch and connection options ([#3386](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3386)) ([7e10c08](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/7e10c08d30172f4a9d0dba64fa21890afebed09a))
* **input:** note that press_key cannot drive native <select> popups on macOS ([#3288](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3288)) ([8e79bd0](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/8e79bd09632613d24c3124c367e874dc85469602))


### ⚡ Performance

* **memory:** drop async parents of request initiators in NetworkCollector ([#3345](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3345)) ([ca6f834](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/ca6f83498014e74243117a2aa3830cf71091d64d)), closes [#3344](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3344)


### 🏗️ Refactor

* re-export only used Zod runtime members from third_party barrel ([#3439](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3439)) ([6b056c8](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/6b056c848a981c5ecb493f6e22edd6701964a06d))
* reuse Zod schemas and validate integer viewport dimensions ([#3367](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/issues/3367)) ([3c609da](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp/commit/3c609da38a39067f4a0b885ce81968eb958b76a8))

name: Spec Kit - 1.4.0
body:
## Install

```bash
uv tool install specify-cli --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v1.4.0
specify init my-project
```

## What's Changed

- chore: bump version to 1.4.0
- Use handle-based reads in FileHelper (#5351)
- chore: limit automatic Python 3.11 tests to Linux (#5367)
- Harden initial URL validation in HTTP helpers (#5350)
- Update SpecKit Companion extension to v0.26.0 (#5365)
- Use handle-based text overwrites in FileHelper (#5353)
- Require HTTPS consistently for catalog sources (#5355)
- feat(workflows): workflow functions - project-installed custom pipe filters (#5303)
- feat(integrations): map reasoning effort and context size for Copilot, Codex, and Claude Code (#5249)
- [bundle] Update Spec Kit for Azure DevOps bundle to v0.3.2 (#5346)
- [extension] Add T-Shirt Sizing Gate extension to community catalog (#5332)
- fix(scripts): treat option-like feature descriptions as text in create-new-feature.sh (#5245)
- fix(self-upgrade): don't offer a .dev0/.post0 build's base tag as the rollback version (#5358)
