## 2026.11.3

### Highlights

- **Private task results:** Keep private subagent completions out of streamed chat replies. (#188490) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
- **Reliable child-task handoffs:** Allow a parent to hand off to replacement work after cancelling a child, without leaving the cancelled child's completion receipt blocking the handoff. (#178893; related #178565) Thanks @brianmcguire and @letsc4.
- **Visible tool failures:** Report unanswered tool failures instead of silently ending a user-addressed turn as a success. (#182458; related #99645) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @rdleclerc.
- **Bounded authentication:** Stop stalled provider authentication at the run deadline and propagate cancellation through authentication work. (#189144) Thanks @amittell.
- **Sandboxed image access:** Keep required-sandbox image previews inside allowed folders, even in Full Access mode, while preserving explicit administrator image allowances. (#176203) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **Verified workspace connections:** Preserve saved node certificate pins when an empty fingerprint is supplied, and verify workspace-transfer certificates before sending credentials or data. (#125646, #190002) Thanks @wanyongstar and @avelev99.
- **Faster, responsive Gateway:** Reduce startup module-file loading overhead and avoid stalls when abort-command detection encounters long punctuation runs. (#192217, #184433) Thanks @karkarl, @RomneyDa, @LeizhenZhang, and @obviyus.

### Changes

No new configuration options or features.

### Fixes

- **Credential isolation:** Keep reused and cached plugin results scoped to their connection credentials, and keep other plugins' transport hooks on the provider's origin. (#178444, #177974, #189423) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
- **Search and memory credentials:** Keep Firecrawl search and scrape keys with their scoped endpoints and embedding credentials with their destination. (#190706, #184966) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt and @eleqtrizit.
- **Credential redaction:** Redact inline environment credentials from configuration reads and reflected search credentials from Exa errors. (#190618, #178745) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yetval.
- **Child-process environments:** Prevent managed Signal daemons and bundled language servers from inheriting unrelated Gateway secrets. (#179198, #179415) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Authentication errors:** Surface credential-read failures rather than treating them as missing credentials, and reject explicitly selected auth profiles belonging to incompatible providers. (#173970, #181597) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Channel safety:** Keep incoming Twitch IRC content out of parser error logs and require explicit request IDs when multiple Tlon approvals are pending. (#174552, #186243) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @mmaps.
- **Scheduled jobs:** Handle queued cron storage failures without exiting the Gateway, and clear one-shot cleanup when a job becomes recurring. (#175678, #168985) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @yxshee, @wangmiao0668000666, and @obviyus.
- **Updates:** Let profile-backed updates recognize their own maintenance lock and preserve cancellation when ledger writes are deferred. (#177792, #187998) Thanks @GrahamMcBain and @vincentkoc.
- **Update recovery:** Recover safely when the initial package-presence check times out, requiring a fresh valid directory identity before replacement and retaining rollback to the original package. (#181906) Authored by @steipete.
- **Anthropic usage caps:** Recognize exhausted plural usage-limit errors without spending the transient rate-limit retry budget. (#176186; related #176179) Thanks @sunlit-deng and @blue-dot-1.
- **Terminal sessions:** Forward /reset soft to the Gateway instead of hard-resetting the session. (#172431) Thanks @yetval and @obviyus.
- **Git recovery:** Preserve uncertain command failures during Git repair rather than treating an unconfirmed operation as successful. (#176006) Authored by @steipete.
- **Memory provider selection:** Accept mixed-case none and auto provider values. (#186310) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @sagealice2002-dotcom.

name: openclaw 2026.9.37
body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, published from a retired maintenance line by explicit maintainer decision. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.11.2](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.11.2)

## 2026.9.37

### Highlights

- **Private inspection stays private:** paired-node photos and screenshots are no longer automatically attached to replies, and explicit media-read denials are honored when preparing reply attachments. (#174814, #184964) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Responsive replies and pages:** long zero-width Telegram table cells and malformed plugin SVG transforms no longer stall the Gateway or browser page. (#183217, #182674) Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif Authored by @steipete. Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif.
- **Linked accounts survive resets:** sessions keep their person-linked model account through `/new`, `/reset`, and idle or daily rollover. Fixes #179432. (#179433) Thanks @masatohoshino Authored by @steipete. Thanks @masatohoshino.
- **Safer update recovery:** interrupted snapshot writes preserve the previous rollback point, and profile-backed updates and Doctor maintenance no longer trip over their own maintenance ownership. (#189946, #177792, #187104) Thanks @kaguranananana, @GrahamMcBain, and @RomneyDa Authored by @steipete. Thanks @kaguranananana, @GrahamMcBain, and @RomneyDa.
- **Connections recover cleanly:** channel accounts can recover after a manual stop times out, and ClickClack reconnects after silent network drops. Fixes #184852. (#177444, #184853) Thanks @masatohoshino, @YangManBOBO, and @obviyus.
- **Windows state access works across path aliases:** equivalent Windows paths preserve the same state ownership instead of falsely reporting offline maintenance. Fixes #176163. (#176174) Thanks @tjarrau-dev Authored by @steipete. Thanks @tjarrau-dev.

### Changes

- **Faster plugin admission:** reuse native-reference validation within the same admission capture instead of repeatedly walking companion directories, while revalidating replacement captures and recovery copies. Fixes #162047. (#162254) Thanks @WG-Mojo Authored by @steipete. Thanks @WG-Mojo.

### Fixes

- **Private diagnostics:** omit suppressed reply text and background command contents from verbose diagnostics while retaining status metadata. Thanks @steipete.
- **Media boundaries:** keep paired-node inspection photos and screenshots private by default, and honor explicit read denials for reply attachments without blocking authorized managed outputs. (#174814, #184964) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Restrictive group policies:** Doctor preserves explicitly empty group allowlists, inherited settings, and disabled group policies instead of populating fallback senders. Fixes #173826. (#174787) Thanks @lockhartheavyindustries Authored by @steipete. Thanks @lockhartheavyindustries.
- **Discovery output:** escape terminal control characters in untrusted Gateway discovery fields. (#183355) Thanks @Alix-007.
- **State and write outcomes:** recognize committed SQLite writes whose worker result cannot be serialized, avoiding unsafe replay, and preserve Windows ownership across equivalent path spellings. Fixes #176163. (#177321, #176174) Thanks @tjarrau-dev Authored by @steipete. Thanks @tjarrau-dev.
- **Session accounts:** retain linked model-account selections and their provenance through explicit resets and automatic rollover. Fixes #179432. (#179433) Thanks @masatohoshino Authored by @steipete. Thanks @masatohoshino.
- **Channel recovery:** recover channel accounts after timed-out manual stops and restore ClickClack message reception after silent network drops. Fixes #184852. (#177444, #184853) Thanks @masatohoshino, @YangManBOBO, and @obviyus.
- **Local tool connections:** replace unexpectedly closed MCP loopback listeners and retain their cleanup work for shutdown rather than leaving later tool calls permanently disconnected. Fixes #139340. (#183352) Thanks @SC-10749 and @eli-pavlov Authored by @steipete. Thanks @eli-pavlov and @SC-10749.
- **Telegram and Control UI:** bound the processing of long zero-width table cells and malformed SVG transform strings without changing valid table or icon rendering. (#183217, #182674) Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif Authored by @steipete. Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, and @SebTardif.
- **Command results and temporary files:** preserve a completed command's exit result when detached-descendant cleanup is uncertain, retain a visible cleanup warning, and remove temporary MCP configuration directories when writing fails. Fixes #179555. (#185636, #179603) Thanks @xiaopan-xydt and @Yolo521-bot Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Yolo521-bot and @xiaopan-xydt.
- **Gateway credentials:** keep local password SecretRefs active when a separate remote token is configured, and retain a saved node TLS pin when the fingerprint option is empty or whitespace-only. (#128175, #125646) Thanks @TheAngryPit, @CassieMei, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @wanyongstar.
- **Update and restart reliability:** preserve rollback snapshots after interrupted writes, release completed maintenance before reopening requester policy, confirm predecessor stop receipts during Doctor maintenance, and prepare configuration restarts outside the restart-signal fence. (#189946, #177792, #187104, #172777) Thanks @kaguranananana, @GrahamMcBain, and @RomneyDa Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @kaguranananana, and @GrahamMcBain.
- **Memory jobs and imports:** leave stopped or failure-disabled dreaming jobs disabled, and refresh imported ChatGPT transcript examples without overwriting real Notes sections. Fixes #180655, #193161. (#180694, #193173) Thanks @Yun-0000, @lisandromachado, @KhanCold, and @obviyus Authored by @steipete. Thanks @lisandromachado, @KhanCold, @Yun-0000, and @obviyus.
- **Release artifact verification:** qualify the candidate's exact plugin artifacts, route validation through the admitted verifier, and accept successful admission jobs that omit step details while preserving run, attempt, artifact, and authority checks. (#164464, #173437, #188597) Thanks @RomneyDa.

name: v5.1.69
body:
**OmO runs on senpi 2026.11.10-2.** A client can read and edit the workspace's instruction files over RPC through `read_project_file` / `write_project_file` (senpi#6307), a built session can be parked and handed out through `claim_session` (senpi#6350), the Fable 5.2 prompt preset gains the codebase-ownership sentence (senpi#6360), `generate_image` is eval-only like `bash` (senpi#6272), eval cells reach every eval-only tool through `tool.<name>(...)` and the `agent()`/`output()` helpers (senpi#6276), and the EQ goldens carry the new prompt (senpi#6355). ([#13054](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13054))

**An agent that answered a message from another agent can keep answering it in the turns the engine starts on its own, with no prompt.** The reply allowance a consumed delivery grants (a reply to that sender by id or stated name, approved from the delivery alone) now lasts for the work the delivery started: the consuming turn and every later turn the engine starts by itself - an open-todo reminder, a goal continuation, a monitor wake. A settle alone no longer ends it; it ends when a new message starts work after that answer: a person's message, or any delivery, whose own sender the new group then holds (a delivery that joins running work adds its sender). A reply in a covered turn continues the delivery's chain at the next hop, so the chain limit still closes it. ([#13042](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13042), part of #12996) ([#13044](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13044))

**`omo remote send` now goes through the same delivery pipeline as every other send, and `--steer` reads the session once.** A person's message to a session on another device enters `createDeliveryPipeline` with the relay address book's reference for the `<device>/<session>` address, so the CLI no longer builds its own transport call; the relay transport reads the running turn once and steers it, where the CLI used to read it a second time first. A `--steer` to a session that is running nothing still sends nothing. The unused second prompt implementation (`promptRemote`) and its argument check are removed. Which sender kinds each device admits is unchanged. ([#13038](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13038))

**A message to a session on this device that waits on a question now says so, as one to another device does.** The send is still queued, and its `delivery` now carries `waiting_on: { kind: "approval", device }`. `device` is this install's account device, and is absent when the install has no device identity. ([#13035](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13035))

**Every message one session sends another now names the device it was sent from, on this device and across devices alike, and a message from another device counts as the cause of the receiving run's next send the same way a local one does.** When no device id can be read (no device service, or it does not answer), the message still goes and records why it names no device. ([#13034](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13034), part of [#13004](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13004))

**A message sent or handed off to a session on another device now reports its `delivery_id`, `effective_mode` and `endpoint`, as one sent within this device does.** The answer came from the account's session listing and dropped those fields. It now passes the relay transport's own delivery facts through. The `endpoint` is `null` because the sender knows no endpoint on that device. ([#13033](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13033))

**A reply to an agent on another device now reaches it by the id in the message header or by its name, with no prompt on the same account.** One resolver now finds a thread across this device's threads and the account's other devices: an exact durable id, then an account alias, then the name ladder judged over every entry (two devices sharing a name are an ambiguous_target naming both devices, never a silent pick). `thread_send`, `thread_handoff`, the control tools, `thread_create` (open or fork) and the `omo thread` CLI all use it. A reply to the sender of a delivery the run took in is approved from that delivery alone - by the sender's durable id or the name it stated - and must resolve to that sender, else it is refused as `reply_target_mismatch` without sending. The id shown for a thread on another device is its durable id; the relay listing carries it when the device publishes one. The `omo remote` verbs still dispatch by the id you type as the device's session key, so pass the id the device lists under until that path moves onto the shared resolver. ([#13000](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13000))

**A send to an agent on another device now reports the same facts as one on this device.** `thread_send` and `thread_handoff` answer `delivery_id` and `effective_mode` for a target on another device too, so a caller reads the delivery's id and the lane it took the same way whichever device holds the thread; `message_seq` and `endpoint` stay the facts of a gateway row on this device, and `device` names another one. The reply allowance (a run answering the agent whose delivery it took in, by that agent's id or stated name, with no prompt) is proved identical for a same-device and a cross-device delivery, and one parity table now runs every send assertion against both legs, so a rule that reads the transport fails the build instead of reaching a user. ([#13006](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13006), on top of [#13000](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13000))

**A task child no longer starts against a senpi engine that refused its process-wide redaction registry; the start fails with `SenpiEngineRestartRequiredError`, which says to restart omo.** The engine refuses to load next to a registry slot it did not install, and that refusal lasts for the whole process, so a restart is the only remedy. ([#12991](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12991))

**omo now installs the signed device service 0.1.27 instead of 0.1.3.** The device service pin had stayed at 0.1.3 across every device-service release since 0.1.3, and an installed omo only replaces a service older than its pin, so no machine received a newer one. ([#12981](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12981))

**The `thread_*` tools are now eval-only, like `bash`: when an eval tool is present they are no longer in the model's direct tool list and are called as `tool.thread_*()` inside an eval cell.** Behaviour, permissions and results are unchanged, and without eval they stay ordinary direct tools. ([#12907](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12907), closes [#12903](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/12903))

**A long-running engine keeps reclaiming crashed one-shot memory runs.** The memory component's cleanup of abandoned one-shot runs, which runs once per engine process outside session opens, now repeats once a day in an engine that stays up, such as the desktop's or a daemon host's, instead of waiting for a restart. ([#12899](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12899))

**Opening a session no longer re-sweeps the memory root.** The memory component's cleanup of abandoned one-shot runs now runs once per engine process, shortly after the first open, instead of inside every session open. A session that ends before that cleanup starts hands it to the next open, so crashed runs are still reclaimed. ([#12896](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12896))

### Fixed

- The senpi barrel load-failure test imported the barrel by a pathname-derived `/D:/...` specifier, which failed on Windows and turned dev red (#13068). It now imports the barrel by file URL. ([#13068](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13068))
- Computer use reports a click or typed text that went out as window events with its real input route, and judges whether input landed only for multi-event input such as drags, so a single click whose window then closes is reported delivered. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- The actionability check no longer refuses `press` on a Linux button that lists only another action such as `click`, since the backend presses its first action. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- Computer use flags text typed into a secure field of a background window, and reports how much text was delivered when the user intervenes mid-send. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- On macOS, key priming now bounds and classifies its focus reads, so a slow or failing focus read no longer stalls background typing into a multi-window app. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- Computer use keeps holding the machine-wide interaction lock while it hands key focus back after background typing, so another session can no longer type in between. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- A steer sent to a session on another device that was held behind that session's open draft, and whose turn ended before the draft was released, was answered `queued` and then lost without a word (#12927). The send now records that refusal: a retry of the same send under the same `idempotency_key` answers `turn_conflict`, naming the delivery, instead of `queued`. ([#12935](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12935))

### Changed

- Computer use now lets the user keep typing and clicking while it works by default (`computer.intervention: "continue"`); set it to `"pause"` to have input wait for the user and stop with `UserIntervened`. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- While computer use waits for an accessibility target to become actionable, other computer-use sessions of the same user can keep sending input instead of being refused `InputBusy`; the target is checked once more, without waiting, right before the action. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- Desktop engine: the stop-marker policy is pinned to the XPC-only path and reported by `omo doctor`. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))

### Added

- Computer use waits until an accessibility target is actionable before it acts, lists the sheets, windows and menus an action opened, suggests the next call when it refuses, and refuses `cmd+q`, `alt+f4` and `win+l` unless the key chord is forced. ([#13055](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/13055))
- Wayland (Hyprland): window-targeted pointer input through libei behind a `windowInput` capability probe (`no_eis`, `hyprland_ipc_missing` reasons). ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Wayland (KWin): window-targeted pointer input through the same libei path, and window captures placed on the KWin frame rectangle so coordinates round-trip between capture and click. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- `senpi-desktop-sdk`: the typed facade package for computer-use v2 consumers (connect, Computer / Window / Element / Frame, reports and verification, typed errors), with a pinned facade manifest and a package-boundaries test. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop engine: `skeleton` observation (logical depth 3), the web-wrapper rule, and `root: <ref>` drill with sub-generations (object mode only). ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- `senpi-desktop-sdk`: the spawn transport with the in-session refusal (`spawn_inside_session`); the service run facade routes windows, displays and capabilities through the SDK. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop engine host: features-gated session.open options (intervention, macosKeyPriming, trace, reportMode) sent only when the engine advertises them; `ActionReport` typed exec results with the 7 valid disposition pairs; reserved settings `computer.run_sandbox`, `intervention`, `macos_key_priming`, `trace` (defaults unchanged); error codes `COMPUTER_AMBIGUOUS_TARGET`, `COMPUTER_CAPTURE_CONSENT_REQUIRED`, `COMPUTER_PROTECTED_PROCESS` with `data.reason` hints. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop engine: late replies after a stop are quarantined (`Suspended`, disposition `unknown / unknown`, audited on stderr); macOS helpers (overlay, keymap, canary) gain parent-death containment. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop service: a fresh-process permission re-probe before every session open, so a capture/accessibility grant made after a denial is seen without restarting the service. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- `computer.run`: a QuickJS cell with wall-clock, call and payload limits and an escape battery (no host bridge yet). ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- macOS capture: SkyLight-first window capture with SCK/legacy fallback, capture of windows on another Space, and a measured replayd consent probe (opt-in, never gating). ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop engine: epoch sources (display change, lock, sleep, Space switch, engine restart) announced as `epoch.changed`; stale frames after an epoch move answer `InvalidCoordinateFrame superseded`. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop engine: the ref-generation store keeps 8 live generations per target and up to 65,536 retained objects; refs past their generation answer `StaleRef`. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop engine: object-mode `ax.snapshot` returns a partial observation (`complete`, `nodesObserved`, `cuts`) at a 3000 ms default deadline and a node budget; null mode is byte-equal to v1. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Desktop engine: per-stage timings on action reports and a redacted trace JSONL sink, both behind the `trace` session option (default off). ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Wayland (KWin): window-targeted pointer input through libei behind the `windowInput` capability probe, plus the KDE QA driver. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Kernel `computer` globals (JS and Python preludes) are generated from the SDK facade manifest; `verify` lives on the desktop root, `drill` on window handles. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))
- Wayland (GNOME): window-targeted pointer input through a small Shell extension that publishes the window list over the session bus. ([#12831](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/12831))

name: CC Switch v4.0.29
body:
# CC Switch v4.0.29

本版本新增受管应用 **GitHub Copilot CLI**：自带 Key 的供应商会写进 Copilot 自己的 `providers.json`，在 `copilot` 里用 `/model` 就能和官方模型一起选，不用经过 CC Switch。界面新增韩语和俄语，七种语言从此同步维护，不再有缺的地方显示英文。

另外修复了 Windows 上 Codex 桌面版在 WSL 里运行 Codex 时，用第三方供应商启动就报错；Codex 新对话经路由连第三方原生 Responses 上游报 400；Codex 经路由连 Anthropic 格式上游时，长回答被 8192 的输出上限截断；Codex 官方卡在路由模式下拿不到账号自己的模型列表等问题。

**[English →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.29-en.md) | [日本語版 →](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/docs/release-notes/v4.0.29-ja.md)**

---

## 新增

### GitHub Copilot CLI

GitHub Copilot CLI（`copilot`）成为新的受管应用（[#8753](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8753)，需求见 [#5768](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/5768)）。供应商卡片分两种：

- **官方登录**：用 Copilot CLI 自己的 GitHub 登录，不写任何文件。「打开终端」以卡片上的模型和推理强度启动 `copilot`；卡片绑定了授权中心的 GitHub 账号时，用这个账号启动。卡片上显示该账号的 Copilot 额度。
- **自带 Key 的供应商**：点「添加」后写进 Copilot 自己的 `providers.json`（`$COPILOT_HOME/providers.json`）。之后在本机任何地方启动 `copilot`，都能在 `/model` 里和官方模型并列选到「卡片标识/模型」，请求直接发给供应商，不经过 CC Switch 的路由。不登录 GitHub 也能用。
  - CC Switch 只改这一家自己的条目，文件里的其他条目（Copilot 自己也会写这个文件）和顺序原样保留。`providers.json` 写坏了 Copilot 会起不来，所以写入前会按 Copilot 的规则把整份文件校验一遍，例如模型的最大输出不能占满整个上下文窗口。
  - Copilot 当前默认模型所在的那一家标为默认，不能移除或删除。要换，先在 `copilot` 里用 `/model` 换成别家的模型。
  - 卡片上的终端按钮要添加之后才能用，启动时直接选中这张卡的第一个模型。
  - 预设沿用 Pi 的供应商预设。

此外还支持：

- **MCP、Skills、提示词**：同步到 Copilot 的 `mcp-config.json`、Skills 目录和指令文件。
- **会话管理**：列出 Copilot 会话，可以在终端里恢复。
- **用量统计**：从 Copilot 的会话日志导入用量；自带 Key 的供应商按会话里选中的卡片记账。
- **一键导入链接**：可以导入 Copilot 供应商，认得 `providers.json` 写法，支持 `bearerToken`，链接里的模型 ID 全部保留。

### 韩语、俄语界面，七种语言同步维护

- **韩语**（[#8794](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/8794)，需求见 [#2704](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/2704)）和**俄语**（[#7788](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/7788)，需求见 [#6010](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/6010)）：首次启动按系统语言自动选择，托盘菜单和快捷面板也已翻译。用量统计的币种新增韩元（KRW），支持自动获取汇率。
- 土耳其语、韩语、俄语不再是「社区翻译、缺的地方显示英文」：界面上的每一句话，中文简体、中文繁体、English、日本語、한국어、Türkçe、Русский 七种语言都有，之后新增和修改文案也会七种语言一起改。
- 升级后弹出的更新摘要暂时只有中文简体、中文繁体、英文和日文，其他语言显示英文。

---

## 变更

- **Copilot 获取模型列表为空时说明原因**（[#5500](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/5500)）：Copilot Free 账号能拿到模型，但没有一个可以在模型选择器里用，以前只提示没有找到模型。现在会提示这个账号可能没有开通 Copilot Pro；Claude Code 和 Claude Desktop 的表单还会提示可以手动填写 `gpt-4.1` 或 `gpt-4o`。账号有模型、但都不支持当前选择的上游格式时，Codex 表单会单独说明。

---

## 修复

- **Windows 上 Codex 桌面版在 WSL 里运行 Codex 时，用第三方供应商一启动就报「No such file or directory (os error 2)」**（[#9375](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9375)）。v4.0.27 起，CC Switch 在 `config.toml` 里把模型目录文件写成 Windows 绝对路径，WSL 里的 Codex 读不懂这个路径，直连、路由、聚合三种模式都受影响。现在在 Windows 上、Codex 桌面版开启了在 WSL 中运行 Codex 时，改回只写文件名，下次写入时自动改正。
- **Codex 新对话经路由连第三方原生 Responses 上游时报 400**（[#9328](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9328)，相关 [#7074](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7074)、[#9379](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9379)）。新版 Codex 桌面版会在新对话里带上没有 `call_id` 的页面上下文工具结果，自动化和跨任务派发的回执也是这样，校验严格的上游会拒绝整个请求。以前只对 xAI 改写，现在对所有非官方的原生 Responses 上游都改写成一条用户消息，内容保留。官方订阅和带 `call_id` 的工具结果不受影响。
- **Codex 经路由连 Anthropic 格式上游时，长回答被截断，报「Incomplete response returned, reason: max_output_tokens」，重试也一样**。Codex 请求不带输出上限，以前按 8192 发出，思考也算在内，一次写一整个文件的工具调用就会用完。现在默认改为 32000。上游的输出上限更低时会报 400，可以在供应商的「最大输出 tokens」里填它支持的值。
- **Codex 官方卡在路由模式下拿不到账号自己的模型列表**：Codex 只能用它自带的列表，缺少账号专属的模型；Codex 桌面版打开 Daybreak 后，官方模型全部变灰。现在路由正在用官方卡、且没有打开「暂停使用官方登录」时，路由会把官方的模型列表原样交给 Codex。第三方供应商不转发。
- **Claude Code 经路由连 Mistral 上的 DeepSeek 模型时，工具调用之后的每一轮都报 422**（[#9385](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9385)、[#9388](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9388)）。
- **只能经路由使用的 Claude Code 卡片，点「打开终端」后 Claude Code 每句话都提示未登录（「Not logged in」），请求根本没发出去**。GitHub Copilot、Codex OAuth、xAI OAuth 这类卡片的凭据由路由提供，非 Anthropic 格式的卡片要靠路由转换格式，终端直连卡片地址用不了。现在这类卡片的「打开终端」按钮变灰，并说明要开启路由后在终端里直接运行客户端。Codex 页面上这类卡片也从隐藏按钮改为同样变灰。
- **Claude 官方卡显示的额度可能是另一个账号的**：本机默认登录换成别的账号后，正在用的那张卡会读到默认登录那个账号的额度。现在会先确认默认登录属于这个账号。
- **Antigravity 的额度和 `agy /usage` 对不上；Google AI Ultra 5x 和 20x 都只显示「Google AI Ultra」**（[#9317](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/9317)、[#9319](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/pull/9319)）。

---

## 致谢

感谢 @Owlbay（GitHub Copilot CLI）、@cuiyf5516（韩语界面、韩元币种）、@sunrisegm（俄语界面）、@szcascsa（Codex 没有 `call_id` 的工具结果）、@quwang123（Mistral 上的 DeepSeek）、@jimpablo（Antigravity 额度与 Ultra 档位）的贡献。

特别感谢以下贡献者：你们的 PR 发现并修复了真实的问题，只是同样的问题后来在主线上另行修好，PR 因此关闭。@SailingLoong（Codex 配置不再写入 `disable_response_storage`）、@zichen0116（Codex 经路由发往第三方时去掉 ChatGPT 身份头）、@lihenga（Codex 桌面版页面通知缺少 `call_id`）。

感谢 @SMYQH、@Irving798、@imysen、@THao712、@Z-Eternal、@sumi-0011、@DrMaks22 提出需求、报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

name: v2.14.10 — ad-creative (2.12.5 → 2.13.0): ten new static ad templates from a review of long-running…
body:
- **ad-creative** (2.12.5 → 2.13.0): ten new static ad templates from a review of long-running ads in public ad libraries: Apology Letter ("We're so sorry"), Important Update, Reassurance List ("Stop thinking something is wrong with you"), Simple Guarantee, With / Without, Venn Diagram, Stages (progression comic), Character Story ("This is Mike"), Signs Checklist, and Exaggerated Visual. Their tiers are marked provisional. A new **visual styles** table (dark mode, retro screen, billboard, notice board, presentation slide, whiteboard, handwritten sign, mirror writing, news card, newspaper, vintage, illustration, meme, retro app frame) restyles any template, with rules for styles that borrow a real look: no copied mastheads, no fake system dialogs or "sensitive content" screens, no tabloid claims. Health templates note Meta's personal-attributes and personal-health rules. The format map clarifies that the F-tier fake-native rating covers ads posing as a real interface, not decorative retro frames.

## Skill ZIP assets

Complete source catalog: 53 skills.
Claude web target: 53 skills with reviewed short descriptions.
Perplexity Computer target: 53 skills.

Choose `<name>-claude-web.zip` for the documented single-folder web upload format.
Choose `<name>-perplexity.zip` for Perplexity Computer (SKILL.md at the archive root).
Source ZIPs retain original metadata; they are not substitutes for omitted web ZIPs.
Live client upload, account limits, and invocation behavior have not been verified.

Web omissions (also recorded in `claude-web-manifest.json`):
- None.

name: Sub2API 0.2.21
body:
> AI API Gateway Platform - 将 AI 订阅配额分发和管理

新增 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2 支持；OpenAI 用量与计费区分 30m/12h 缓存写入 TTL，并根据实例内存上限自动设定请求体内存预算，减少高并发下误报 503 的情况。

## 新增功能

- 支持 Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2：包括模型目录、Anthropic 预设、Bedrock 映射、OpenCode 配置和兜底定价（$8/$40 每百万 token，Fast 模式 2 倍）
- OpenAI 缓存写入计费按 TTL 拆分：渠道、分组、账号统计价卡新增独立的 12h 缓存写入价（GPT-5.6 / GPT-6 系列未配置时默认按输入价 2.5 倍；已配置通用写入价的价卡不受影响），管理员用量详情按实际 TTL 展示
- Antigravity 账号用量单元格新增「查询」按钮，可跳过缓存强制刷新用量
- EasyPay 支付实例可单独配置退款成功码（默认 1，可选 0），兼容退款以 code=0 表示成功的易支付网关

## 优化改进

- 请求体内存预算未配置时，自动取进程内存上限的 1/4（取物理内存、cgroup 限制、GOMEMLIMIT 中的最小值），最低 1GiB
- API 密钥列表不再等近 30 天用量统计返回才渲染，并为用量统计新增覆盖索引，大数据量下 /keys 页面不再长时间停在骨架屏
- 账号列表刷新时保留现有行和配额数值，不再整表闪烁成骨架屏
- 系统设置页的保存按钮改为吸附在视口右下角的浮标，长表单不用滚到底部也能保存
- 余额充值倍率支持最多 6 位小数，便于跟随实时汇率
- 安全审计任务入队后立即唤醒本进程 worker 认领，不再平均等待约 250ms
- OpenAI WebSocket 首 token 时间改为遵循管理员配置的 TTFT 口径，与 SSE 保持一致
- 客户端未提供会话标识时，Responses 会话种子在工具回合中保持稳定，减少粘性会话中途切换账号
- 内置 Claude Code CLI 版本基线升至 2.1.321

## Bug 修复

- 修复 OpenAI 合成的 reasoning effort 未应用 effort 映射规则和上限校验的问题；保留已配置的 GLM 降级语义
- 修复 OpenAI 显式配置的模型级冷却规则对 overloaded/slow_down 及流内 503 不生效的问题；关键词只匹配实际错误字段
- 修复 Codex 元数据事件（codex.rate_limits 等）提前提交响应流，导致后续上游过载无法 failover 的问题
- 修复原生 Responses WebSocket 在后续轮次限流时重放首帧，可能导致任务上下文错乱的问题（现以 1013 关闭，由客户端重连）
- 修复 OpenAI OAuth 池化 WebSocket 在未声明搜索的连接上发起 web_search 被上游拒绝的问题
- 修复 Codex Desktop 注入的页面上下文导致首个 Responses 请求返回 400 的问题
- 修复原生 Codex 生图请求因心跳提前写出 200、掩盖上游错误状态码的问题
- 修复 /v1/responses 重建函数调用时丢失 encrypted_function_args 与 namespace 的问题
- 修复 CC Switch 的 reasoning 封装被当作 encrypted_content 发往上游的问题
- 修复 Anthropic 兼容路径（Chat Completions / Responses）忽略账号自定义错误策略的问题
- 修复 Gemini 兼容入口非流式响应把思考摘要混入正文的问题
- 修复 Antigravity 并行工具结果中的图片打断 functionResponse 序列导致上游 400 的问题
- 修复 Antigravity Pro 账号 Argon 配额与其他 Gemini 配额共用冷却、互相误伤的问题
- 修复账号信息加载失败时已占用的并发槽位未释放、要等 TTL 过期才恢复的问题
- 修复刷新令牌并发轮换时同一令牌可被重复使用的问题
- 修复定价目录哈希与内容版本不一致时，后续同步一直被跳过的问题
- 修复 Sonnet 5.5 兜底缓存读取价格错误的问题（改为 $0.10 每百万 token）
- 修复 OpenAI 普通输入免费时 Fast 倍率丢失的问题
- 修复含非法 UTF-8 的 Responses 请求体被当作上游可重试错误的问题，现直接返回 400

## 升级指南

- 本次新增两个数据库迁移，升级时自动执行。其中 249 在 usage_logs 上用 CONCURRENTLY 建索引，不锁表，但表较大时首次启动会耗时较长
- 请求体内存预算的配置键是 gateway.request_body_memory_budget_bytes（v0.2.20 发布说明误写为 security.*），需要固定值时请显式设置



---

## 📥 Installation

**Docker:**
```bash
# Docker Hub
docker pull weishaw/sub2api:0.2.21

# GitHub Container Registry
docker pull ghcr.io/wei-shaw/sub2api:0.2.21
```

**One-line install (Linux):**
```bash
curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash
```

**Manual download:**
Download the appropriate archive for your platform from the assets below.

## 📚 Documentation

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api)
- [Installation Guide](https://github.com/Wei-Shaw/sub2api/blob/main/deploy/README.md)

name: v0.5.4.1
body:
## 中文

### 修复与改进

- **资源 write**：修正文件处理与父目录刷新的衔接，保留每个文件自身的摘要和索引工作；父目录独立刷新，不替代尚未完成的文件索引。`wait=true` 等待文件自身的处理完成，不等待父目录 L0/L1 和目录索引刷新，请求参数不变。[#7383](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7383)
- **目录摘要**：待刷新期间复用已有文件摘要；恢复 `semantic.overview_sample_limit` 默认 32 项的稳定采样，文件自身仍完整建立索引。[#7380](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7380)、[#7387](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7387)
- **存储稳定性**：修复 `stat` 按记录 ID 查询的兼容性、向量 Collection 生命周期，以及多写元数据不完整时的启动问题。[#7377](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7377)、[#7355](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7355)、[#7381](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7381)
- **Connector 与流式响应**：支持带作用域的 OAuth 引用，原生导入保留 Connector Watch；修复 Gateway 流式错误的结束标记。[#7259](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7259)、[#7364](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7364)、[#7010](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7010)

### 其他更新

新增多写 backup 动态切换、账户管理的 global 系统 Skill 目录、火山引擎浏览器授权配置，并更新 Console、FileBrowser、Wiki 和 Agent 体验界面。详见[完整变更](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/v0.5.4...v0.5.4.1)。

### 升级说明

```bash
pip install --upgrade 'openviking==0.5.4.1'
```

- 目录 `stat` / `ls` 的 `count` 现在只统计可见的 L2 记录，不再把 L0/L1 摘要记录计入。[#7264](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7264)
- OIDC 的非法账户或用户标识会被拒绝，不再通过字符替换映射为其他身份。[#7116](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7116)
- 本次只发布主包 `openviking`；独立 Python SDK、CLI 和 React 包保持各自的发布版本。源码集成 React 模块的项目需关注本范围内标记为 breaking 的组件接口变更。

## English

### Fixes and improvements

- **Resource write:** Correct the coordination between file processing and parent-directory refresh. Each file retains its own summary and indexing work, while parent directories refresh independently without superseding pending file indexing. `wait=true` waits for the file's own processing, not parent L0/L1 summaries or directory indexing. Request parameters are unchanged. [#7383](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7383)
- **Directory summaries:** Reuse existing file summaries during pending refreshes and restore stable sampling through `semantic.overview_sample_limit`, with a default of 32 entries. Each file still receives its own index. [#7380](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7380), [#7387](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7387)
- **Storage stability:** Fix `stat` compatibility for record IDs, vector Collection lifecycle handling, and startup with incomplete multiwrite metadata. [#7377](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7377), [#7355](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7355), [#7381](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7381)
- **Connectors and streaming:** Support scoped OAuth references, retain Connector Watches on native imports, and preserve Gateway stream error terminators. [#7259](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7259), [#7364](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7364), [#7010](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7010)

### Other updates

Add dynamic multiwrite backup switching, account-managed global system Skill directories and VolcEngine browser authorization setup, and update Console, FileBrowser, Wiki and Agent interfaces. See the [full changelog](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/compare/v0.5.4...v0.5.4.1).

### Upgrade notes

Use `pip install --upgrade 'openviking==0.5.4.1'`.

- Directory `count` in `stat` / `ls` now counts visible L2 records only, excluding L0/L1 summary records. [#7264](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7264)
- Invalid OIDC account or user identifiers are rejected instead of being mapped to another identity through character replacement. [#7116](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7116)
- This publishes the main `openviking` package only. Standalone Python SDK, CLI and React packages retain their independent release versions. Source integrations of the React modules should review the component API changes marked as breaking in this range.

## 首次贡献者 / New contributors

感谢 / Thanks to [zhouliangyi-dance](https://github.com/zhouliangyi-dance) ([#7274](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7274)), [zuoanCo](https://github.com/zuoanCo) ([#6905](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/6905)), and [AtaraxiaZ](https://github.com/AtaraxiaZ) ([#7077](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking/pull/7077)).

name: career-ops v1.40.0: No Silent Drops
body:
<!-- co:release-notes:career-ops-v1.40.0 -->
This release is about saying what career-ops did not read or did not keep. A board it read only in part is logged `partial` instead of `reachable`, a template tag the PDF renderer drops gets a warning, and a CV bullet whose verb drifted from the bullet you wrote is blocked.

## Highlights

- **A board read in part says so.** A board that career-ops could read only in part is now logged `partial`, not `reachable` (#6636), and boards that failed on a temporary error get one more try after the sweep (#6675), both by @kellymmcgrath. Before the headed-browser retry, the liveness check reads the site's robots.txt first (#6551 by @benbalter).
- **Your CV, held to your own facts.** A generated bullet whose verb drifted from its source bullet is blocked (#6630 by @kellymmcgrath), structured facts are bound to the records they came from (#6016 by @luochen211), and a build with an unresolved `{{token}}` fails instead of printing it (#6408 by @sogav21). `cv-templates.mjs lint cv <name> --render` warns about what the renderer drops in silence, such as scripts and remote fonts (#5943 by @rubicon).
- **Bring your tracker with you.** `import-tracker.mjs` imports the CSV export of another tracker (#6170), and the scan keeps a posting's close date and shows it in the pipeline (#6597), both by @mbrow190.
- **One ask at a time.** career-ops asks for a GitHub star once, after your first report, and for the manifesto later, never in the same run. The asks that were spread across scan, doctor and update now live in one place (#6700).
- **Twelve more places to look.** HiBob, HireHive and ALDI Nord (#6502, #6503, #6529 by @ilyakanevskiy), every Workable tenant through Workable's public XML feed (#6793 by @ilyakanevskiy), Polymer and Trakstar Hire (#6128, #6131 by @mbrow190), Tes (#6731 by @AdilAzhariOmsan), TurboHire (#6712 by @okeken), any employer's job sitemap (#6631 by @kellymmcgrath), Remote's own ATS (#6392 by @artemtrofymenko), ADP Recruiting Management (#6678 by @dgitman) and SEEK NZ (#6488 by @prateek942).

## Updating

Run `node update-system.mjs apply --confirm` in your career-ops folder. If you said no to the update prompt earlier, this is the same command.

### Thank you

This release carries 239 pull requests from 58 people, 20 of them contributing for the first time.

name: v15.17.0
body:
## New: claude-mem memory for eve agents

- **`claude-mem/eve`** is a new export of the `claude-mem` npm package. It is a memory provider for [eve](https://eve.dev), Vercel's framework for durable backend agents. An eve agent can now recall what you did in Claude Code, Codex and your other claude-mem clients, using your [cmem.ai](https://cmem.ai) memory (key from cmem.ai/pro/key) (#5863).
  - **Recall:** one search before every turn. No inference spend. Matches reach the model as escaped data, never as instructions.
  - **Tools:** `<slot>__search` to look further back and `<slot>__remember` to save a note. Both are bound to the slot's scope.
  - **Separate memory per caller:** each eve scope gets its own claude-mem project by default. `searchAllProjects` reads the whole account and is for single-owner agents only.
  - **No automatic capture:** eve can replay a capture step, and that would save the same turn twice, so saves only happen when the model calls `remember`.
  - **Failures stay visible:** if cmem.ai can't be reached, the turn still runs, the failure is logged, and the model is told memory is unavailable.
  - Requires eve 0.84.0 or later and Node.js 24 or later. `eve` and `zod` are optional peer dependencies, so nothing changes for existing installs.
- **One-click eve personal agent template** at [`integrations/eve/template`](https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/tree/main/integrations/eve/template): password-protected web chat with your claude-mem memory. Deploy with Vercel and enter two values, `EVE_CHAT_PASSWORD` and `CLAUDE_MEM_API_KEY`. iMessage is an eve add-on (`npx eve add channel/linq` or `channel/photon`); only texts from `CLAUDE_MEM_OWNER_PHONE` get your memory.

Quick start for an existing eve agent:

```bash
npm install claude-mem
```

```ts
// agent/memory/claude-mem.ts
import { claudeMem } from "claude-mem/eve";
import { defineMemory } from "eve/memory";
import { byPrincipal } from "eve/memory/scope";

export default defineMemory({
  description: "Recall and save durable context for the current user.",
  provider: claudeMem({ apiKey: process.env.CLAUDE_MEM_API_KEY }),
  scope: byPrincipal,
});
```

Docs: https://docs.claude-mem.ai/eve-integration

No changes to the Claude Code plugin's capture, worker or hooks in this release.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.16.1...v15.17.0

name: v15.16.1
body:
## Critical fix

- **Manual saves work again in projects with older manual sessions.** In v15.16.0, `save_memory` (and `POST /api/memory/save`) returned HTTP 500 with `UNIQUE constraint failed: sdk_sessions.memory_session_id` in any project whose manual session was created before 15.16.0 with an older session ID shape. Every save in that project failed. claude-mem now finds and reuses that older session instead of trying to create a duplicate. Deleted sessions still get a fresh ID, as in 15.16.0 (#5842).

If you are on 15.16.0, update to 15.16.1.

## New (both off by default)

- **Opt out of bundled skills:** list skill names in `CLAUDE_MEM_SKILLS_DISABLED` in `~/.claude-mem/settings.json`, as a comma-separated string or a JSON array (for example `"make-plan,do,smart-explore"`). The list is re-applied after installs, repairs and marketplace updates; new skills stay enabled unless you name them (#5837, thanks @liuyinchu, closes #5132).
- **Line anchors in file context:** set `CLAUDE_MEM_LINE_ANCHORS_ENABLED` to `"true"` and past observations about a file point at the line where that code is now (`@L123`), or say `(code changed since)` when it moved away. Nothing is guessed. With the setting off, nothing is recorded and the hook output is unchanged (#5841, thanks @devkancheti4-design, closes #4943).

## Fixes

- **OpenClaw:** the installer works on OpenClaw 2026.11.2 again, and current OpenClaw records prompts, injects context and summarizes sessions without the removed `before_agent_start` hook. Older OpenClaw versions behave as before (#5840, fixes #5838, reported by @JesseFranzen).
- **Warp uninstall:** `npx claude-mem uninstall` now removes the `claude-mem` MCP server that `install --ide warp` adds to `~/.warp/.mcp.json`, instead of leaving it pointed at the deleted plugin (#5839, thanks @tanishqbaweja).
- **Telemetry IDs:** recording a consent decision (installer prompt, `telemetry enable`, `telemetry disable`) keeps the saved anonymous ID, so one install no longer shows up as two. The `telemetry enable` disclosure now lists the events actually sent (#5836, thanks @wiesenthal).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.16.0...v15.16.1

name: v15.16.0
body:
## New

- **My Work refresh on your API provider (opt-in):** set `CLAUDE_MEM_WORK_VIEW_AGENT=api` to run the My Work refresh on the provider you already selected (`openrouter`, `openai-compatible`, or the legacy `cmem` spelling). Installs with no logged-in Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI (for example OpenCode or DSH hosts) can now use My Work. With an API provider selected and the setting empty, the refresh no longer falls back to a logged-in Claude Code: no agent runs and nothing is spent until you choose one (#5674, thanks @bulanovk).
- **GitHub MCP pull requests in My Work:** pull requests created through GitHub's official MCP `create_pull_request` tool now show up as My Work products. Only completed results whose URL matches the requested repository are accepted (#5809, thanks @Afloat16).
- **UberLLM preset:** `uberllm` is now a preset of the `openai-compatible` provider (`https://api.uberllm.dev/v1`, default model `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`) (#5706, thanks @PSA-Team-source).
- **Tunable live handoff timeout:** `CLAUDE_MEM_HOOK_HANDOFF_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 250) sets the budget for the single live handoff from a hook to the worker, and a missed handoff is now logged at WARN instead of DEBUG (#5831, thanks @mohitdixit02).

## Notable fixes

- **Plugin cache cleanup:** the worker now prunes old version folders that Claude Code's marketplace updates leave in `~/.claude/plugins/cache/thedotmack/claude-mem/` (one report: 21 versions, about 16 GB). It keeps the running copy and the registered version, and sweeps after boot settles and then hourly (#5685, thanks @MaxWang007).
- **Windows antivirus noise:** install, update and launcher rebuilds no longer start a hidden PowerShell when the launcher folder is already on PATH, the pattern Kaspersky flagged (#5835, reported by @Ali-Sabri-0).
- **My Work language:** when `CLAUDE_MEM_WORK_VIEW_TEXT_LANGUAGE` is empty, every refresh step now writes in the system locale's language, so one run no longer mixes languages (#5669, thanks @0xABCD01).
- **My Work idle cost:** idle polling no longer rescans every synced row, and the live overview, focus-area merging and heavy panels do less work per update (#5834).
- **Backups:** a declined backup run returns a failure, saved backups are reported separately from retention errors, backup intervals beyond the timer limit are honored, and restore rejects stamped snapshots missing worker tables (#5750, #5781, #5784, #5684, thanks @Kirat0201).
- **Shell setup:** the launcher PATH block and the legacy uninstall alias are written atomically, Cowork stages spooled events under `$HOME` when the host sets it, and Hermes keeps permanent HTTP client errors out of its circuit breaker (#5680, #5679, #5677, #5678, thanks @DeryFerd).
- **OpenCode:** the bash tool is reported as `Bash`, so `SKIP_BASH_PATTERNS` applies (#5668, thanks @ryrenz).
- **Sync:** a failed Chroma cleanup after a delete is retried (#5673, thanks @Zhong-fan).
- **SessionStart:** the cache read and compose steps share one body budget, so a cached body is served only when it fits (#5686, thanks @Varshith-Kali).

## More fixes

About 130 smaller fixes from @Afloat16 across capture, sync, search, context, import, transcripts, media, the server, and the Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Grok, Kimi, Gemini, Pi, Goose, Notion and Telegram integrations. Highlights:

- **Search and context:** literal project keys and file paths are preserved through recall, merges and caching; Unicode and combining marks survive query words and snippet limits; cached context expires after restores and row replacements; the largest fitting timeline prefix is kept.
- **Sync and memory:** session titles commit with their outbox mutation and get receiver redaction; manual saves and new prompts work after a session deletion; note revisions survive title dedup.
- **Transcripts and import:** multipart Codex messages, paired patch results and zstd frame seams are read correctly; reasoning stays out of final answers; OpenCode, Gemini and restored summaries import without duplicates or lost prompts.
- **Server and providers:** API key derivation stays off the request loop; cancellations propagate through retries and compression; split token usage is metered on compatible replies; memory content is sanitized before storage.
- **Media:** image ordinals, Read evidence across path spellings, and advertised image dimension bounds are preserved; inline allowance is charged only for accepted images.

Also from @Kirat0201: file history follows whole project merges, interactive timeline search honors project lists, and unified search keeps literal `filePath` values (#5789, #5787, #5785).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.15.2...v15.16.0

name: v15.15.2
body:
## Critical fix

- **Antigravity no longer denies every tool call after an upgrade from 14.x (#5670):** an in-place upgrade from an older install left a `PreToolUse` hook (and a `PreInvocation` context hook) in `~/.gemini/config/hooks.json`. agy kept firing it before every tool call, the current adapter answered with no decision, and agy denied every call until you re-ran install. Now the Antigravity installer finds those stale entries and migrates the file in place with the same merge install performs. It writes only when something is stale, never throws, and leaves a corrupt file untouched. The worker runs this heal on startup and on Antigravity hook calls, so updating is enough. Thanks to @jiezhiyong for the report (#5665) and to @0xABCD01 for the fix.

## Fixes

- **Antigravity:** a model call that only called tools no longer becomes an "AntigravityProvider returned Completed" memory. Only a step with a real reply is recorded, so the observer stops writing false memories like "stuck in a retry loop" (#5667, thanks @ryrenz; reported in #5665 by @jiezhiyong).
- **Redaction:** with `CLAUDE_MEM_REDACT_ENABLED=true`, server capture now applies the configured redactor before the capture leaves your machine, and to session and event metadata before it is stored. Before, an untagged credential in an opening prompt or tool payload could be sent over HTTP unredacted (#5774, thanks @Afloat16).
- **Doctor:** `claude-mem doctor` now checks the macOS launcher's code signature. A launcher macOS would kill gets a clear hint (`bun upgrade` first when Bun is below 1.4.1, otherwise `npx claude-mem install` rebuilds it); a launcher that still runs only warns (#5657, thanks @Kirat0201).
- **cmem-pro 0.2.1:** the Cowork plugin version is bumped so installed copies pick up the redaction and failed-capture fixes made after 0.2.0.

## New

- **Turkish My Work:** the My Work page is now available in Turkish (#5656, thanks @Kirat0201).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.15.1...v15.15.2

[中文](#cn-v0.2.2-rc.2) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-rc.2)

新增功能

- Git Worktree 支持按分支、提交和文件类型审阅改动，并直接处理 GitHub 评审、同步已审阅进度和更新分支。 @LegGasai - SubAgent 支持具名与多层协作，AgentTeam 可按会话开启，共用成员与任务面板。 @Dudu-0223, @Yifffan - 桌面端支持在设置中切换正式版与开发版更新渠道。 @winewill ### 体验优化 - 改善代码审阅时的评论、文件导航与窄屏布局，减少查看大型改动时的卡顿，并放宽大型仓库创建工作树的等待时间。 @LegGasai - 改善多层子代理的浏览与任务协调，优先展示任务描述，支持逐层展开和读取失败后重试。 @Dudu-0223 - 优化左侧栏插件入口的收纳，不常用入口可移入“更多”，重新固定时保持原顺序。 @Yifffan - 简化个性化页面安装后的操作，移除“保留”按钮，统一使用撤销与恢复。 @ZiyaZhang - 改善自定义主题对通知、卡片、计划和任务等界面颜色的覆盖。 @turtle2099 - 改善页面缩放、平移及长列表场景下的菜单定位，保持菜单与触发位置对齐；自定义浮层需适配新定位接口。 @Stevring, @LegGasai - 改善暗色模式下文件树浮层的显示，使用背景层次区分面板，避免白色投影。 @turtle2099 - 改善在侧栏查找文件的体验，支持按名称或路径搜索，并可调整排除规则与隐藏文件显示。 @yudshj - 改善侧栏长列表的浏览与拖动体验，插件导航和会话列表共用滚动区域，工作区工具栏保持可见。 @Yifffan - 优化从会话打开工作目录的操作，统一“在应用中打开”菜单，并改善窄屏使用体验。 @Yifffan - 加快文件右键菜单的打开；关联应用查询较慢时，先提供默认应用入口。 @yudshj - 向上回看聊天时自动加载更早消息，优先保持阅读位置，并保留手动加载和重试入口。 @imccyu - 改善聊天过程的可查看性，可展开工作区指令、技能目录等信息，了解模型收到的上下文。 @turtle2099 - 改善补丁编辑的回执，折叠状态下也可查看修改的文件，并在成功后直接打开。 @sjw1231 - 优化会话首页的交互动画。 @ZiyaZhang - 改善会话恢复或压缩后的上下文提示，明确当前运行信息与旧信息的替换关系。 @kermanx - 改善聊天中代码差异的阅读，显示增删行颜色，并按文件语言高亮。 @mektpoy - 改善粘贴图片和文件的体验，未聚焦输入框时也可粘贴到最近使用的可用输入框或主对话。 @std4453 - 改善暂停、恢复定时任务时的操作反馈，保持按钮焦点与显示稳定，避免重复操作。 @turtle2099 - 优化目标栏的操作排列与按钮间距，统一为“编辑、清除、暂停或恢复”。 @turtle2099 - 优化模型请求失败后的重试设置，可在模型设置中选择重试条件、次数和等待时间。 @turtle2099 - 改善临时请求失败后的恢复操作，可直接点击“继续生成”，无需另写消息。 @LegGasai - 改善 API Key 的管理，已保存密钥以掩码显示，支持整体替换或清除，不显示完整旧密钥。 @Magolor - 优化多问题检索，单次网页搜索默认支持最多 10 个查询和 10 个来源。 @turtle2099 - 改善 Agent 终端的可见性与接管体验，命令在侧栏终端运行，用户输入即可接管；允许读取的用户终端内容会进入模型与会话记录。 @LegGasai - 优化批量查询文件、任务和资源时的执行效率，更多只读工具可并行运行，结果仍按调用顺序返回。 @turtle2099 - 改善桌面更新下载时的进度显示，可点击下载百分比或“检查更新”查看状态。 @winewill ### 问题修复 - 修复 PR 更新后审阅差异与提交行号不一致的问题，并改善大量评审讨论的统计。 @LegGasai - 修复只有 SSH 凭据时无法查看私有 Git 插件详情的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复可选插件加载失败导致整个 Web 页面无法启动的问题；必需插件失败仍会提示。 @imccyu - 修复已启用但未成功加载的插件容易被误认为正在运行的问题，明确显示“未运行”及原因。 @turtle1999 - 修复 PTC 中重复等待子代理消息时，同一条消息反复触发唤醒的问题。 @Dudu-0223 - 修复浏览特殊文件名或扩展名时，文件树视图崩溃的问题。 @LegGasai - 修复“未分组”会话中显示无效“新建会话”按钮的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复复制聊天公式时出现乱码的问题，同一条 Markdown 内容中的公式可复制为 TeX 源码。 @turtle2099 - 修复查看 Perl 代码时，正则表达式导致后续内容高亮错误的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复聊天更新出错后，历史加载和新消息显示持续卡住的问题。 @Magolor - 改善重复创建会话分支时的标题编号，跳过已用编号，减少同名会话。 @turtle2099 - 修复停止任务或关闭会话时，部分错误导致任务未中止或资源提前释放的问题。 @liukx0205 - 修复发送消息或准备附件期间重试请求，导致同一消息被重复提交的问题。 @liukx0205 - 修复中文目标栏混淆“待继续”与“已暂停”状态的问题。 @imccyu - 修复桌面端多次启动后，因鉴权信息累积而无法启动的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Windows 通过短路径启动命令行时，无法保存欢迎页确认的问题。 @winewill - 修复 macOS 窗口拖动与粘贴快捷键问题，以及 Windows 暗色模式启动白闪。 @yxy72, @winewill, @turtle2099 - 改善 Windows 更新安装期间的反馈，显示安装状态窗口，减少重启过程中的无提示等待。 @winewill - 修复移动端 Safari 在展开屏幕或切换视口后，聊天文字被额外放大的问题，保留用户主动缩放。 @Saafo - 修复 Linux 存在长期后台进程时，会话加载与新建变慢的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复会话中移除或替换工具后，部分模型拒绝继续请求的问题。 @Tuyixiang - 通过 Anthropic Messages 接入时，历史前缀变化后省略失效的签名 thinking，减少压缩后持续请求失败。 @turtle2099 - 修复部分模型网关错误被误报为“API 密钥无效”的问题，使重试按实际响应状态处理。 @LegGasai - 修复在 DSH 用户目录中配置 DeepSeek 端点后无法启动的问题；项目目录中的环境配置仍不能覆盖端点。 @LegGasai - 修复连续浏览多页 PDF 时加载越来越慢、快速翻页卡顿的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复使用 Inspector 查看较大的 Cordis 树时，快照接近上限可能导致服务退出的问题。 @turtle2099 ### 其他变更 - 网页搜索默认改用 DeepSeek Search API，搜索与获取可分别选择计费账号或 API Key；旧提供方和自定义配置需按升级指南调整。 @yudshj - 归档会话默认清理符合条件的 Git 工作树，保留分支与提交；需保留本地目录时请关闭清理，自定义配置与 Forge 插件需迁移。 @LegGasai - AgentTeam 改用统一的具名子代理，中断工具默认关闭；自定义插件与 SDK 集成需迁移，共享会话的进程须同步升级。 @Dudu-0223 - SDK 可通过配置为新会话默认开启团队协作，恢复已有会话时保留原选择。 @Dudu-0223 - 允许插件动态注册和移除 MCP 服务，并查询状态、重启或探测连接，无需用户逐项维护服务配置。 @LegGasai - 插件可按语言扩展聊天代码块的显示，未匹配或渲染失败时回退为普通代码块。 @imccyu - 插件索引可提供 GitHub Star 和 npm 周下载量，默认仍按索引提供的顺序排列。 @turtle1999 - Creator 的开发指引统一到 dsh-doc，用于定制 DSH 并查阅当前版本资料；引用旧技能名称或路径的扩展需迁移。 @turtle1999 - 自定义模型提供方支持 Gemini 原生接口，可获取模型列表并设置推理等级。 @turtle2099 - 模型请求的 User-Agent 增加启动配置标记，便于服务端区分桌面端、Web、命令行与 SDK 请求。 @imccyu - 调整账号通知，支持产品公告等消息并随界面语言更新；已有登录保留，自定义账号插件与配置需迁移。 @lsdsjy - PTC 按运行时限限制工具调用总量，超限会终止代码并清空保留状态，已完成的操作不会撤销。 @kermanx - Session 支持批量追加事件，日志格式不变；自定义追加接口的包装代码需适配批量调用。 @liukx0205 - 工具失败提供更明确的错误类型与代码，便于定位问题；依赖旧错误分类的插件和 SDK 集成需同步适配。 @sjw1231 - 调整 Computer Use 的窗口操作、键盘控制和授权，默认不移动系统鼠标；自定义脚本与 helper 需同步升级。 @CreatixChu, @Tuyixiang, @Dudu-0223 - Office 改用原生工具，Web 与 SDK 均可加载技能；旧包和技能需迁移，文档解析在 DSH 主进程中运行，不受命令行沙箱保护。 @yudshj - Windows 的额外目录授权仅供文件工具使用，不扩大终端或 PTC 的访问范围；相关沙箱扩展需迁移。 @Tuyixiang - 调整 LiveShare 的多会话分享与插件授权，旧授权需重新配置；PTC 可访问分享目录之外，仅应分享给可信任的人。 @mektpoy - npm 安装与桌面端随附对应版本的源码和文档，方便查阅与开发扩展；Python 单文件运行时不包含这些资源。 @turtle1999 - 升级 Zod 至 4.6.6、Stagehand 至 4.4.0；Stagehand 改为自动发现扩展，旧 extensionId 配置不再生效。 @imccyu

New Features

- Git Worktree supports reviewing changes by branch, commit, and file category, with GitHub reviews, synchronized viewed-file progress, and branch updates directly in DSH. by @LegGasai - SubAgent supports named, multi-level collaboration, while AgentTeam can be enabled per session with a shared member and task panel. by @Dudu-0223, @Yifffan - Desktop settings now let you switch between stable and development update channels. by @winewill ### Improvements - Improve commenting, file navigation, and narrow-screen layouts during code review, reduce lag when viewing large changes, and allow more time to create worktrees in large repositories. by @LegGasai - Improve browsing and coordinating nested subagents, prioritizing task descriptions and supporting incremental expansion and retries after failed reads. by @Dudu-0223 - Improve sidebar plugin organization: move infrequently used entries into More and restore them without changing their original order. by @Yifffan - Simplify actions after installing personalized pages, replacing Keep with Undo and Restore. by @ZiyaZhang - Improve custom-theme coverage for notifications, cards, plans, tasks, and other interface colors. by @turtle2099 - Improve menu positioning during page zooming, panning, and browsing long lists, keeping menus aligned with their triggers; custom panels need to adopt the new positioning API. by @Stevring, @LegGasai - Improve dark-theme file-tree panels with layered backgrounds instead of white shadows. by @turtle2099 - Improve file discovery in the sidebar with name and path search, exclusion rules, and hidden-file controls. by @yudshj - Improve browsing and dragging in long sidebar lists, with plugin navigation and sessions sharing a scroll area and workspace controls remaining visible. by @Yifffan - Streamline opening a session's working directory through a consistent Open in menu, with improved narrow-screen usability. by @Yifffan - Open file context menus faster; when application lookup is slow, offer a default-app action first. by @yudshj - Automatically load earlier messages when scrolling up through chat, prioritizing reading-position stability while retaining manual loading and retry controls. by @imccyu - Make chat activity easier to inspect by expanding workspace instructions, skill catalogs, and other context received by the model. by @turtle2099 - Improve patch-edit receipts by listing affected files even when collapsed and allowing them to be opened after successful edits. by @sjw1231 - Improve interaction animations on the session home screen. by @ZiyaZhang - Improve context reminders after session resume or compaction by clarifying how current runtime information replaces older information. by @kermanx - Improve reading code diffs in chat with added and removed row colors and per-file syntax highlighting. by @mektpoy - Improve image and file pasting without a focused composer, routing content to the most recently used available composer or the main conversation. by @std4453 - Improve feedback when pausing or resuming scheduled tasks, keeping focus and appearance stable while preventing duplicate actions. by @turtle2099 - Refine goal-bar action order and spacing to Edit, Clear, and Pause or Resume. by @turtle2099 - Improve model-request retry settings with configurable retry conditions, counts, and wait times in model settings. by @turtle2099 - Make recovery from transient request failures easier with Continue generating, without requiring another message. by @LegGasai - Improve API-key management with masked previews and full replacement or removal, without revealing the complete saved key. by @Magolor - Improve multi-question research with up to 10 queries and 10 sources per web-search call by default. by @turtle2099 - Make Agent terminals visible in the sidebar and let users take over by typing; user-terminal content that agents are permitted to read enters model context and session records. by @LegGasai - Improve batch file, task, and resource queries by allowing more read-only tools to run concurrently while returning results in call order. by @turtle2099 - Improve Desktop update progress displays, with status available from the download percentage or Check for updates. by @winewill ### Bug Fixes - Fix PR updates causing displayed diffs to use mismatched commit line numbers, and improve counts for large numbers of review threads. by @LegGasai - Fix private Git plugin details failing to load for users with SSH-only credentials. by @turtle2099 - Fix optional plugin failures preventing the entire Web app from starting; required-plugin failures remain visible errors. by @imccyu - Fix enabled but unloaded plugins appearing to run, clearly showing Not running and the reason. by @turtle1999 - Fix repeated waits for subagent messages within PTC waking repeatedly for the same message. by @Dudu-0223 - Fix file-tree crashes when browsing special filenames or extensions. by @LegGasai - Fix a nonfunctional New Session button appearing in the Ungrouped session header. by @turtle2099 - Fix garbled formula copying in chat, copying formulas within a single Markdown document as TeX source. by @turtle2099 - Fix Perl regular expressions incorrectly coloring subsequent code. by @turtle2099 - Fix history loading and new-message displays remaining stuck after a chat-update error. by @Magolor - Improve title numbering when repeatedly branching a session, skipping used numbers to reduce duplicate names. by @turtle2099 - Fix some errors during task cancellation or session shutdown leaving work running or releasing resources prematurely. by @liukx0205 - Fix retried requests during message submission or attachment preparation submitting the same message more than once. by @liukx0205 - Fix the Chinese goal bar confusing goals awaiting continuation with paused goals. by @imccyu - Fix accumulated authentication data preventing Desktop startup after repeated launches. by @turtle2099 - Fix welcome-screen confirmation failing to save when the Windows CLI is launched through a short path. by @winewill - Fix macOS window dragging and paste shortcuts, and white flashes when starting Windows in dark mode. by @yxy72, @winewill, @turtle2099 - Improve feedback during Windows update installation with an installation-status window, reducing unexplained waiting during restarts. by @winewill - Fix mobile Safari enlarging chat text beyond the configured font size when unfolding or changing the viewport, while preserving manual page zoom. by @Saafo - Fix long-running background processes slowing session loading and creation on Linux. by @turtle2099 - Fix some models rejecting further requests after tools are removed or replaced in a session. by @Tuyixiang - For Anthropic Messages connections, omit invalid signed thinking after history-prefix changes to reduce persistent request failures after compaction. by @turtle2099 - Fix some model-gateway failures being misreported as invalid API keys, allowing retries to follow the actual response status. by @LegGasai - Fix startup failure after configuring DeepSeek endpoints in the DSH user directory; project environment settings still cannot override these endpoints. by @LegGasai - Fix progressively slower loading and rapid-page-navigation stalls when browsing multi-page PDFs. by @turtle2099 - Fix inspecting large Cordis trees potentially terminating the service when snapshots approach the size limit. by @turtle2099 ### Chores - Web search now defaults to DeepSeek Search API, with separate account or API-key billing choices for Search and Fetch; migrate older providers and custom settings using the upgrade guide. by @yudshj - Archiving sessions cleans up eligible Git worktrees by default while preserving branches and commits; disable cleanup to retain local directories, and migrate custom configuration and Forge plugins. by @LegGasai - AgentTeam uses unified named subagents, with the interrupt tool disabled by default; migrate custom plugins and SDK integrations and upgrade all processes sharing session storage together. by @Dudu-0223 - SDK configuration can enable Team collaboration by default for new sessions while preserving the saved choice when resuming existing sessions. by @Dudu-0223 - Plugins can dynamically register and remove MCP servers, query their status, restart them, and probe connections without requiring users to maintain each server configuration manually. by @LegGasai - Plugins can extend chat code-block rendering by language, falling back to ordinary code blocks when no renderer matches or rendering fails. by @imccyu - Plugin indexes can provide GitHub stars and weekly npm downloads while keeping the order supplied by the index as the default. by @turtle1999 - Creator guidance consolidates into dsh-doc for customizing DSH and consulting current-version resources; extensions referencing old skill names or paths need migration. by @turtle1999 - Custom model providers support the native Gemini API, including model discovery and reasoning-level settings. by @turtle2099 - Model-request User-Agent headers include the active profile, helping servers distinguish Desktop, Web, CLI, and SDK requests. by @imccyu - Account notifications support announcements and refresh with the interface language; existing sign-ins are retained, while custom account plugins and configuration need migration. by @lsdsjy - PTC limits total tool calls according to its runtime budget; exceeding the limit terminates the code and clears retained state without undoing completed operations. by @kermanx - Session supports batched event appends without changing the log format; custom append wrappers need to support batch calls. by @liukx0205 - Tool failures provide clearer error types and codes for diagnosis; plugins and SDK integrations relying on older classifications need updating. by @sjw1231 - Adjust Computer Use window operations, keyboard control, and authorization, keeping the system pointer still by default; upgrade custom scripts and helpers together. by @CreatixChu, @Tuyixiang, @Dudu-0223 - Office uses native tools, with skills available in Web and SDK sessions; migrate old packages and skills. Document parsing runs in the DSH host process outside the shell sandbox. by @yudshj - Windows extra-directory grants apply only to file tools, not terminal or PTC access; related sandbox extensions need migration. by @Tuyixiang - Adjust LiveShare multi-session sharing and plugin authorization; reconfigure old grants. PTC can access files outside the shared directory, so share only with trusted people. by @mektpoy - npm installations and Desktop include matching source code and documentation for reference and extension development; Python single-file runtimes exclude these resources. by @turtle1999 - Upgrade Zod to 4.6.6 and Stagehand to 4.4.0; Stagehand automatically discovers extensions, and the old extensionId setting no longer takes effect. by @imccyu Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.1...dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2

## First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support `--channel`. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against `SHA256SUMS`, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable `jcode` on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted `.exe`.

From that preview binary, run `jcode update --channel preview` (substitute its full path for `jcode`) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with `update --channel stable`, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the `v1.0.0` stable tag is created.

## First-time preview setup

Existing stable versions do not support `--channel`. Download the archive for your OS and architecture from this release, verify it against `SHA256SUMS`, and extract the entire archive into its own directory (keep all Linux companion files together). Run the extracted binary explicitly, using its full path, rather than the old stable `jcode` on PATH. For Windows, use the extracted `.exe`.

From that preview binary, run `jcode update --channel preview` (substitute its full path for `jcode`) to persist the opt-in channel and receive future previews. To roll back, run the preview binary with `update --channel stable`, or reinstall the current stable release. Stable users are never moved to previews automatically.

This preview series ends when the `v1.0.0` stable tag is created.

name: MinerU 4.2.1
body:
## 4.2.1

- **修复 Doclib 截断续读遗漏内容**。Markdown 文档或单页读取在 `context=0` 时，达到长度限制后通过 `next_request.locator` 与 `next_request.after` 继续读取当前页的剩余内容，读完后再建议下一页。CLI 续读标记和 SDK 文档同步更新。
- **完善托管解析服务的故障恢复**。连续启动或重启失败达到上限后停止自动重试，并清理残留进程。重新设置托管模式或档位、重启文档库服务后可再次尝试恢复。切换模式、档位及关闭服务时，完善旧进程和控制通道的回收。
- **修复 Windows 托管服务端口探测**。按照服务实际绑定行为检查端口，在非严格端口模式下跳过已占用或被系统保留的端口，减少探测成功后仍无法启动的问题。
- **改善文档库服务的优雅退出**。通过宿主停机回调执行生命周期清理，使 Windows 关闭流程也能回收后台任务、托管解析进程和数据库资源。
- **修复 Windows GPU 显存信息缺失**。完善 DXGI 与硬件库存的 PCI 地址匹配，在同型号设备条目存在歧义时保留一致的显存和设备属性，提高硬件诊断信息的完整性。
- **修复原生 PDF 正文缺失**。接受因浮点误差接近 360° 的正常文本方向，避免水平文字在原生文本回填时被错误过滤。

**集成提示**。嵌入式 Doclib 宿主需要设置 `shutdown` 回调以支持关闭接口，缺少回调时返回 `service_unavailable`。标准 `mineru server` 入口已配置该回调。

---

## 4.2.1

- **Complete Doclib continuation after truncation**. Markdown document and single-page reads with `context=0` use both `next_request.locator` and `next_request.after` to resume the unfinished page after reaching the output limit, then suggest the next page. CLI continuation markers and SDK documentation follow the same contract.
- **Bound managed parse-server recovery**. Stop automatic retries after repeated startup or restart failures and clean up remaining processes. Setting the managed mode or tier again, or restarting the document library server, allows recovery to resume. Improve process and control-channel cleanup during mode changes, tier changes, and shutdown.
- **Correct Windows managed-port probing**. Match the server's actual binding behavior and skip occupied or system-reserved ports when strict-port mode is disabled, reducing startup failures after a successful port probe.
- **Graceful document library shutdown**. Use a host shutdown callback to run lifecycle cleanup, including background tasks, managed parsing processes, and database resources on Windows.
- **Restore Windows GPU memory information**. Improve PCI-address matching between DXGI and the hardware inventory, and retain consistent memory and device properties when same-model entries have ambiguous identities.
- **Preserve native PDF body text**. Accept normal text directions close to 360° due to floating-point error, preventing horizontal text from being filtered during native text restoration.

**Integration note**. Embedded Doclib hosts must provide a `shutdown` callback to support the shutdown endpoint. A missing callback returns `service_unavailable`. The standard `mineru server` entry point already provides the callback.

升级 / Upgrade

```bash
pip install -U "mineru==4.2.1"
```

[完整变更 / Full changes](https://github.com/opendatalab/MinerU/compare/mineru-4.2.0-released...mineru-4.2.1-released)

name: graphify 0.9.106
body:
## graphify 0.9.106

- Fix: **install** `requires-python` is capped to `>=3.10,<3.15`, so `uv tool install graphifyy` (and pip) on a fresh machine no longer selects Python 3.15 — for which `tree-sitter` has no wheel — and then fails with a source build that needs a C compiler (`No such file or directory: 'cc'`). uv now picks a wheel-having interpreter (3.14) by default, with no `--python` flag and no compiler needed. The Ubuntu/Debian README line that asked for `python3.12` (absent on Debian 12 and Ubuntu 22.04) is replaced with the uv installer or a plain `python3`/pipx line (#5134).
- Fix: **cpp** a plain class/struct forward declaration folds into its unique exactly-qualified definition when one file reaches the other through unconditional exact quoted includes, and a parameterless member declaration folds into its proven out-of-line definition by matching return type and qualifiers; overloads, templates, conditional declarations and unproven includes stay separate (#5117, thanks @xRedLeader).
- Fix: **cpp** a member call resolves through a scoped type alias (`using Alias = ns::Type;`) and through inherited fields/methods, and a forward-declared pointee type is completed at the use site; ambiguous, virtual or diamond-inherited receivers fail closed (#5118, thanks @xRedLeader).
- Fix: **cpp** an out-of-line template member keeps its proven primary-template owner, and calls inside a `#if`-guarded initializer or argument list are recovered from byte-preserving branch views (bounded, fail-closed on malformed/over-budget input); dependent receivers stay unresolved (#5115, thanks @xRedLeader).
- Fix: **python** a dotted subscript annotation (`mod.MyBox[Foo]`) counts its value once as the type instead of also as its own generic argument, so the false `generic_arg` reference no longer replaces the real `parameter_type`/`return_type` edge (#5113, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **ts/js** a call through an ESM namespace import (`import * as ns from './m'; ns.f()`), a CommonJS whole-module require (`const m = require('./m'); m.f()`), or a TS `import = require` resolves to the real declaration; fail-closed on an unknown module, a non-exported name, or an ambiguous barrel (#5114, #5129, thanks @mohitdixit02).
- Fix: **llm** a precomputed `FileSlice` input is preserved through `extract_corpus_parallel` instead of crashing or stamping a partial parent complete; a slice that covers only part of its file marks the parent partial for re-dispatch (#5106, #5128, thanks @aadilrizwan).
- Fix: **query** BFS walks levels in a fixed, hash-independent order, so a query's edge lines (and which survive the token budget) no longer vary with `PYTHONHASHSEED` (#5109, #5112, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Feat: **query** `--no-doc-demotion` (and the `demote_docs` rc key / MCP arg) disables the source-over-docs soft weight for a docs-first corpus; code corpora are unaffected by default (#5084, #5116, thanks @mohitdixit02).
- Perf: **resolution** `_collision_aware` indexes salted sibling ids once instead of rescanning all nodes per use, cutting resolution time on large collision-heavy corpora (graph output byte-identical) (#5108, #5111, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **manifest** a `pom.xml` using a prefixed, single-quoted or spaced `xmlns` keeps its Maven package and dependency nodes instead of losing them; a foreign namespace is not double-counted (#5126, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
- Fix: **merge-graphs** `graphify merge-graphs` reports how many external nodes were unified across repos instead of silently absorbing them; the merge result is unchanged (#5127, thanks @igorpugatschev).
- Fix: **diagnostics** `diagnose_extraction` no longer crashes on a malformed `nodes` container (null or scalar); the malformed extraction is still surfaced through the build error (#5125, thanks @sdivyanshu90).
- Fix: **html** the interactive graph no longer draws a hyperedge region over members hidden by a community toggle; a region vanishes once fewer than two of its members stay visible (#5122, thanks @Yi-111-a).

The AST cache schema is bumped to 43; warm caches re-run the affected Python and C++ extractions.

name: browser-use 1.0.2
body:
Fixes on 1.0.1.

- **MCP with Chrome's remote debugging off:** `browser-use --cli-mcp` now drives its own Chromium instead of stopping at the chrome://inspect steps, and tells your agent how to switch to your Chrome (tick "Allow remote debugging" at chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging, restart the MCP server).
- **Slow pages:** CDP calls from the CLI and MCP wait 20 s, like the agent. A page frozen by a JS dialog fails fast with an error that says to handle the dialog.
- **Windows:** `open()` in MCP `browser_exec` code reads and writes UTF-8.
- **Feedback:** tell us what broke with `browser-use feedback "..."` or `browser_use.feedback("...")`. The agent can call `report_issue(...)` and MCP clients get a `browser_feedback` tool. Text is scrubbed before it leaves.

```bash
uv add 'browser-use==1.0.2'
```

name: 1.0.2rc1: release candidate for 1.0.2
body:
> Release candidate for 1.0.2. Install it explicitly: `pip install 'browser-use==1.0.2rc1'`. Plain installs still get 1.0.1.

- `--cli-mcp` with Chrome remote debugging off now drives its own Chromium and tells the model how to get your Chrome (toggle at chrome://inspect, restart the server).
- CLI and `--cli-mcp` CDP calls wait 20 s; a page frozen by a JS dialog fails fast with a clear error.
- Windows: `open()` in `browser_exec` code defaults to UTF-8.
- Feedback: `report_issue` in the agent, `browser-use feedback`, and the `browser_feedback` MCP tool.

# Cua Driver 0.47.9

## Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

## Fixes

- refuse input to macOS security and consent prompts. ([#7338](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/7338)) Thanks @AlexFalher.

## Contributors

Thanks to @AlexFalher for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
